DEVICE PROTECTION PLAN TERMS
Issued by Synthetic Policy Office 1

1. Definitions
1.1. Accessories means cases, chargers, earbuds and styluses.
1.2. Accessories means cases, chargers and earbuds.
1.3. Assessed loss means the cost of repair or replacement agreed by us, before any service fee, limit or sublimit is applied.
1.4. Authorised repairer means a repairer approved in writing by us.
1.5. Battery replacement means replacement batteries and battery repairs.
1.6. Business day means Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays.
1.7. Device means the item shown in the schedule, bought new from an authorised retailer.
1.8. Family means your spouse or partner and any children who live with you.
1.9. Incident means a single event, or a series of events arising from one cause.
1.10. Limit means the most we will pay for all claims under a section arising from one incident.
1.11. Manufacturer's warranty period means the first 12 months after the device was bought.
1.12. Policy period means twelve months from the policy start date shown in your schedule.
1.13. Premium means the amount you must pay for this policy, including any taxes.
1.14. Proof of purchase means an original receipt, invoice or bank statement showing the item, the price and the date.
1.15. Receipt means a document from the seller or provider showing the date, the amount paid and what was supplied.
1.16. Schedule means the document issued with this policy that shows your details, the covers you bought and any extensions.
1.17. Sublimit means a lower limit that applies to a particular class of property or treatment within a section.
1.18. Wearables means smartwatches and fitness trackers.

2. Limits and service fee
2.1. Accidental Damage: limit $800 per incident; service fee $79 per claim.
2.2. Breakdown: limit $1,500 per incident; service fee $25 per claim.
2.3. Theft and Loss: limit $800 per incident; service fee $99 per claim.
2.4. Any limit or sublimit is applied to the assessed loss first, and the service fee is then deducted from the result.

3. Breakdown
3.1. We will repair or replace your device if it stops working because of an electrical or mechanical fault.
3.2. No cover applies under this section to any incident that happens within the first 45 days after the policy start date.
3.3. The most we will pay for Battery replacement under this section is $80 per incident.
3.4. We will not pay for breakdowns during the manufacturer's warranty period.
3.5. We will not pay for breakdown caused by liquid getting into the device.

4. Optional cover: Theft and Loss
4.1. We will replace your device if it is stolen or lost.
4.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
4.3. The most we will pay for Accessories under this section is $100 per incident.
4.4. We will not pay for loss or theft of property left unattended in a vehicle or in a public place. This exclusion does not apply to property locked out of sight in the boot or trunk of a locked vehicle.
4.5. We will not pay for theft that was not reported to the police.

5. Accidental Damage
5.1. We will repair or replace your device if it is accidentally damaged.
5.2. The most we will pay for Accessories under this section is $100 per incident.
5.3. The most we will pay for Wearables under this section is $250 per incident.
5.4. We will not pay for cosmetic damage, such as scratches or dents, that does not affect how the device works.
5.5. We will not pay for damage following a repair by anyone other than us or an authorised repairer. This exclusion does not apply if we approved the repair in writing beforehand.

6. General exclusions
6.1. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
6.2. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
6.3. We will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits us from paying.
6.4. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.
6.5. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
6.6. We will not pay for loss of value or loss of use that does not involve physical loss or damage.

7. Making a claim
7.1. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.
7.2. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
7.3. You must notify us of a claim within 60 days of the incident. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.

8. Interpretation
8.1. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the meaning of this policy.
8.2. Words in the singular include the plural and the other way round.
8.3. Words defined in the definitions section have the same meaning wherever they appear in bold or with an initial capital.

9. Replacement devices
9.1. If we cannot repair your device economically, we will replace it with a replacement device.
9.2. Replacement devices may be a different colour and may be refurbished to an as-new standard.
9.3. Accessories are replaced only if they were lost or damaged in the same incident as the device.

10. Inflation
10.1. We may adjust limits at renewal in line with a published index of consumer prices.
10.2. Any adjustment will be shown in your renewal documents; limits do not change during a policy period.

11. How to read this document
11.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
11.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
11.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

12. Repair process
12.1. After a claim is accepted, we will send a prepaid mailer or book a courier collection.
12.2. We aim to return repaired devices within 5 business days of receiving them.

13. Environmental commitment
13.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
13.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

14. Assignment
14.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

15. Recovery of costs
15.1. If we pay a claim that is later found not to be covered, we may ask you to repay the amount.

16. Market conditions
16.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

17. Automatic renewal
17.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
17.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

18. Salvage
18.1. When we replace an item, the damaged or recovered item becomes our property.
18.2. If stolen property is recovered after we have paid a claim, you must tell us and either return the payment or give us the property.

19. Instalment agreements
19.1. If you pay by instalments, the instalment agreement is a separate contract with the finance provider.
19.2. Ending the instalment agreement does not cancel this policy, but unpaid premium remains due.

20. Accessibility
20.1. This document is available in large print, braille or audio on request.

21. Other insurance
21.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
21.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

22. Change of address
22.1. You must tell us within 30 days if you change your address.
22.2. We may change the premium or the terms from the date of the move.

23. Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
23.1. A person who is not a party to this policy has no right to enforce any of its terms.

24. Arbitration
24.1. If we accept a claim but disagree with you about the amount, the difference will be referred to an arbitrator appointed by both parties.
24.2. Where arbitration applies, obtaining an award is a condition precedent to any legal action against us.

25. Claims documents
25.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.
25.2. We may ask for a medical certificate, a police report or a repair estimate, depending on the claim.

26. Payment of claims
26.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
26.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 5 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

27. Discounts
27.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
27.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

28. Sanctions
28.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

29. Communication
29.1. We will communicate with you in English.
29.2. We may record telephone calls for training and quality purposes.

30. Interest
30.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

31. Severability
31.1. If any term of this policy is found to be invalid, the remaining terms will continue in full force.

32. Data and backups
32.1. We are not responsible for recovering or restoring any data, software or settings stored on your device.
32.2. You should back up your data regularly and before sending the device for repair.

33. Exchange of information
33.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
33.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

34. Cancellation
34.1. You can cancel this policy within 14 days of receiving it and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made.
34.2. After the first 14 days you can cancel at any time; we will refund the premium for the unexpired period less an administration charge of $15.
34.3. We can cancel this policy by giving you 30 days' written notice to the last address we hold.

35. Third-party administrators
35.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.
35.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

36. Transferring the plan
36.1. You may transfer the plan to a new owner of the device by telling us in writing.
36.2. The remaining term of the plan transfers with the device; the term does not restart.

37. Geographical limits
37.1. Cover applies only within the territory shown in the schedule.
37.2. Cover for property temporarily away from its usual place applies only within the same country.

38. Unrecoverable devices
38.1. If a device is found after we have replaced it, the found device becomes our property and must be sent to us.
38.2. We may block devices reported as lost or stolen so that they cannot be used on mobile networks.

39. Reasonable precautions
39.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
39.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

40. Notices

41. Currency
41.1. All amounts in this policy are in US dollars.

42. Fraud
42.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.

1. Definitions
1.1. Art and antiques means paintings, antiques, rugs and other works of art.

1.9. High-risk items means jewellery, watches, laptops, games consoles and cameras.
1.10. Home means the private residence at the address shown in the schedule.
1.11. Limit means the most we will pay for all claims under a section arising from one incident.
1.12. Outbuilding means a shed, garage or greenhouse within the boundaries of the home.
1.13. Policy period means twelve months from the policy start date shown in your schedule.
1.14. Portable electronics means laptops, tablets and mobile phones.

2.2. Escape of Water: limit $15,000 per incident; excess $500 per claim.
2.3. Accidental Damage: limit $2,000 per incident; excess $100 per claim.

3. Arbitration
3.1. If we accept a claim but disagree with you about the amount, the difference will be referred to an arbitrator appointed by both parties.
3.2. Where arbitration applies, obtaining an award is a condition precedent to any legal action against us.

4. Interpretation
4.1. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the meaning of this policy.
4.2. Words in the singular include the plural and the other way round.
4.3. Words defined in the definitions section have the same meaning wherever they appear in bold or with an initial capital.

5. Records and evidence
5.1. You should keep receipts, photographs and valuations for items of significant value.
5.2. Where proof of value is missing, we may base any settlement on the price of a comparable item.
5.3. We may ask for evidence of how and when an item was acquired.

6. Tenant's improvements
6.1. If you rent the home, we will pay for damage to fixtures and fittings that you installed and are responsible for.
6.2. This cover applies only to improvements you paid for, not to items provided by the landlord.

7. Data protection
7.1. We will use the personal information you provide to administer this policy and to handle claims.

7.3. You can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold by writing to our data protection officer.

8. Environmental commitment

8.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

9. Locks and keys
9.1. If the keys to your home are lost or stolen, we will pay the cost of replacing the locks to the outside doors.
9.2. The most we will pay under this clause is $750 for any one claim.

10. Third-party administrators
10.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.
10.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

11. Optional cover: Accidental Damage
11.1. We will pay for sudden and unexpected accidental damage to your contents inside the home.
11.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
11.3. The most we will pay for Portable electronics under this section is $750 per incident.
11.4. We will not pay for damage caused by pets.
11.5. We will not pay for wear and tear, or damage that happens gradually.

12. Instalment agreements
12.1. If you pay by instalments, the instalment agreement is a separate contract with the finance provider.
12.2. Ending the instalment agreement does not cancel this policy, but unpaid premium remains due.

13. Severability
13.1. If any term of this policy is found to be invalid, the remaining terms will continue in full force.

14. Accessibility
14.1. This document is available in large print, braille or audio on request.

15. Duty of fair presentation
15.1. You must answer all questions we ask honestly and to the best of your knowledge.
15.2. If you give incorrect information deliberately or recklessly, we may treat this policy as if it never existed and keep the premium.
15.3. If you give incorrect information carelessly, we may reduce any claim payment in proportion to the premium that should have been charged.

16. Cancellation
16.1. You can cancel this policy within 14 days of receiving it and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made.
16.2. After the first 14 days you can cancel at any time; we will refund the premium for the unexpired period less an administration charge of $25.
16.3. We can cancel this policy by giving you 30 days' written notice to the last address we hold.

17. Taxes
17.1. The premium includes any insurance premium tax at the current rate.
17.2. If the tax rate changes, we may adjust the premium from the date of the change.

18. Notices
18.1. Any notice we give under this policy will be sent to the most recent postal or email address we hold.
18.2. Notices from you should be sent to the address shown in the schedule.

19. Freezer contents
19.1. We will pay for food in a domestic freezer that spoils because of a rise or fall in temperature.

20. Discounts
20.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
20.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

21. Assignment
21.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

22. Communication
22.1. We will communicate with you in English.
22.2. We may record telephone calls for training and quality purposes.

23. Claims documents
23.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.
23.2. We may ask for a medical certificate, a police report or a repair estimate, depending on the claim.

24. Alternative accommodation
24.1. If your home cannot be lived in after damage covered by this policy, we will pay the reasonable cost of comparable temporary accommodation.
24.2. We will also pay for the temporary housing of pets that live with you.
24.3. Cover ends when the home is fit to live in again or after twelve months, whichever is sooner.

25. Payment of claims
25.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
25.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 10 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

26. Electronic documents
26.1. We will send documents by email unless you ask for paper copies.
26.2. You must tell us if your email address changes.
26.3. Documents sent by email are treated as received on the day they are sent.

27. Reasonable precautions
27.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
27.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

28. Premium payment
28.1. You must pay the premium on or before the policy start date or in the monthly instalments shown in the schedule.
28.2. If an instalment is not paid within 21 days of its due date, we may cancel the policy after giving notice.

29. Geographical limits
29.1. Cover applies only within the territory shown in the schedule.
29.2. Cover for property temporarily away from its usual place applies only within the same country.

30. Customer support
30.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
30.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

31. Subrogation
31.1. We will be entitled to take over and conduct in your name the defence or settlement of any claim.
31.2. We can take action in your name to recover any payment we make from anyone responsible for the loss.

32. Salvage
32.1. When we replace an item, the damaged or recovered item becomes our property.
32.2. If stolen property is recovered after we have paid a claim, you must tell us and either return the payment or give us the property.

33. Flood
33.1. We will pay for contents damaged by flood water entering your home.
33.2. No cover applies under this section to any incident that happens within the first 60 days after the policy start date.
33.3. The most we will pay for Garden items under this section is $500 per incident.
33.4. We will not pay for flood damage where a flood warning for your area had been issued before the policy started.

34. Fraud
34.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.
34.2. We may share information with fraud prevention agencies and other insurers.

35. Change of address
35.1. You must tell us within 30 days if you change your address.
35.2. We may change the premium or the terms from the date of the move.

36. Cooperation
36.1. You must give us all the help and information we reasonably need to settle a claim.
36.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

37. Governing law
37.1. This policy is governed by the law of the jurisdiction in which it was issued, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.
37.2. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of that jurisdiction.

38. Exchange of information
38.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
38.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

39. Garden and outdoor cover
39.1. We will pay for plants, trees and shrubs in the garden of the home that are damaged by fire, lightning or theft.
39.2. We will not pay for damage caused by frost, storms, drought or animals.

40. Joint policyholders
40.1. Where more than one person is named in the schedule, each of them is treated as having knowledge of anything any of them knows.
40.2. A notice sent to one named person is treated as sent to all of them.

41. How to read this document
41.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
41.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
41.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

42. Waiver
42.1. If we do not enforce any term of this policy, that does not mean we have given up the right to enforce it later.

43. Complaints
43.1. If you have a complaint, you should first contact our customer relations team, quoting the policy number.
43.2. We will acknowledge a complaint within five working days and aim to resolve it within eight weeks.
43.3. If you remain dissatisfied, you may be able to refer the complaint to an independent ombudsman service.

44. Theft
44.1. We will pay for contents stolen from your home.
44.2. The most we will pay for High-risk items under this section is $1,500 per incident.
44.3. The most we will pay for Bicycles under this section is $800 per incident.
44.4. We will not pay for theft while the home is unoccupied.
44.5. We will not pay for theft where there is no sign of forced entry to the home. This exclusion does not apply where the thief gained entry by deception, for example by posing as a utility worker.
44.6. We will not pay for theft from sheds, garages or other outbuildings. This exclusion does not apply if the outbuilding was locked and the theft involved forcible entry.

45. Contents temporarily removed
45.1. Your contents are covered while temporarily removed from the home to another building in the same country, for up to 60 days.
45.2. Contents in a student hall of residence are covered only if the student is a member of your family.

46. Interest
46.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

47. Escape of Water
47.1. We will pay for contents damaged by water escaping from a fixed pipe, tank or domestic appliance.
47.2. The most we will pay for Art and antiques under this section is $2,000 per incident.
47.3. We will not pay for damage caused by water leaking gradually over a period of time.
47.4. We will not pay for damage caused by the failure of grout or sealant around baths and showers.

48. Sanctions
48.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

49. Compensation scheme
49.1. We are covered by a financial services compensation scheme.
49.2. If we cannot meet our obligations, you may be entitled to compensation from the scheme, depending on the type of policy and the circumstances.

50. Automatic renewal
50.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
50.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

51. General exclusions
51.1. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.
51.2. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
51.3. We will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits us from paying.
51.4. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
51.5. We will not pay for loss of value or loss of use that does not involve physical loss or damage.
51.6. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.

52. Renewal
52.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.
52.2. We are not obliged to offer renewal.

53. Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
53.1. A person who is not a party to this policy has no right to enforce any of its terms.

54. Other insurance
54.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
54.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

55. Changes in circumstances
55.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.
55.2. We may then change the premium or the terms of this policy, or cancel it.

56. Recovery of costs
56.1. If we pay a claim that is later found not to be covered, we may ask you to repay the amount.

57. Market conditions
57.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

58. Making a claim
58.1. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
58.2. You must notify us of a claim within 14 days of the incident. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.
58.3. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.

59. Inflation
59.1. We may adjust limits at renewal in line with a published index of consumer prices.
59.2. Any adjustment will be shown in your renewal documents; limits do not change during a policy period.

60. Currency
60.1. All amounts in this policy are in US dollars.
60.2. Claims for costs incurred in another currency will be converted at the exchange rate on the date the cost was incurred.

EMPLOYEE HEALTH BENEFITS PLAN: SUMMARY PLAN DESCRIPTION
Issued by Synthetic Policy Office 3

1. Definitions
1.1. Assessed loss means the cost of repair or replacement agreed by us, before any deductible, limit or sublimit is applied.
1.2. Business day means Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays.
1.3. Dependant means your spouse or partner, or a child under 21 who is enrolled in the plan.
1.4. Family means your spouse or partner and any children who live with you.
1.5. Frames means spectacle frames bought without new lenses.
1.6. Hearing accessories means batteries, chargers and cleaning kits.
1.7. Hearing aid replacement period means 36 months from the purchase of hearing aids funded by the plan.
1.8. Limit means the most we will pay for all claims under a section arising from one treatment.
1.9. Major restorative work means crowns, bridges, root canal treatment and implants.
1.10. Massage therapy means sports massage, massage therapy and reflexology.
1.11. Network provider means a practitioner or clinic that has an agreement with us to provide treatment.
1.12. Orthodontics means braces and clear aligners.
1.13. Plan year means the twelve months starting on your coverage start date.
1.14. Policy period means twelve months from the policy start date shown in your schedule.
1.15. Premium means the amount you must pay for this policy, including any taxes.
1.16. Proof of purchase means an original receipt, invoice or bank statement showing the item, the price and the date.
1.17. Receipt means a document from the seller or provider showing the date, the amount paid and what was supplied.
1.18. Registered practitioner means a practitioner registered with the professional body for their discipline.
1.19. Replacement period means 24 months from the date of your last eyewear claim.
1.20. Schedule means the document issued with this policy that shows your details, the covers you bought and any extensions.
1.21. Sublimit means a lower limit that applies to a particular class of property or treatment within a section.

2. Limits and deductible
2.1. Dental Care: limit $2,000 per treatment; deductible $50 per claim.
2.2. Vision Care: limit $500 per treatment; deductible $25 per claim.
2.3. Therapy Services: limit $1,500 per treatment; deductible $75 per claim.
2.4. Hearing Care: limit $2,000 per treatment; deductible $100 per claim.
2.5. Any limit or sublimit is applied to the assessed loss first, and the deductible is then deducted from the result.

3. Governing law
3.1. This policy is governed by the law of the jurisdiction in which it was issued, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.
3.2. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of that jurisdiction.

4. Claims documents
4.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.
4.2. We may ask for a medical certificate, a police report or a repair estimate, depending on the claim.

5. Optional cover: Hearing Care
5.1. We will reimburse hearing tests and hearing aids.
5.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
5.3. The most we will pay for Hearing accessories under this section is $100 per treatment.
5.4. We will not pay for replacement hearing aids bought within the hearing aid replacement period.

6. Appeals
6.1. If we decline all or part of a claim, you may appeal in writing within 60 days of the decision.
6.2. An appeal will be reviewed by someone who was not involved in the original decision.
6.3. We will give you a written decision on the appeal within 30 days.

7. Vision Care
7.1. We will reimburse eye tests and prescription eyewear.
7.2. The most we will pay for Frames under this section is $120 per treatment.
7.3. We will not pay for eyewear without prescription lenses.
7.4. We will not pay for a further eyewear claim within the replacement period.

8. Sanctions
8.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

9. Salvage
9.1. When we replace an item, the damaged or recovered item becomes our property.
9.2. If stolen property is recovered after we have paid a claim, you must tell us and either return the payment or give us the property.

10. Data protection
10.1. We will use the personal information you provide to administer this policy and to handle claims.
10.2. We will keep personal information only for as long as it is needed for these purposes or as required by law.
10.3. You can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold by writing to our data protection officer.

11. Therapy Services
11.1. We will reimburse physiotherapy, osteopathy and counselling provided by a registered practitioner.
11.2. The most we will pay for Massage therapy under this section is $200 per treatment.
11.3. We will not pay for treatment of an injury covered by workers' compensation.
11.4. We will not pay for treatment by a practitioner who is not registered with the relevant professional body.

12. Other insurance
12.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
12.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

13. Coordination of benefits
13.1. If a treatment is also covered by another plan, we will pay only the part of the cost that the other plan does not pay.
13.2. You must tell us about any other plan that covers you or your dependants.

14. Environmental commitment
14.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
14.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

15. Assignment
15.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

16. Renewal
16.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.
16.2. We are not obliged to offer renewal.

17. Changes in circumstances
17.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.
17.2. We may then change the premium or the terms of this policy, or cancel it.

18. Dental Care
18.1. We will reimburse the cost of dental treatment provided by a licensed dentist.
18.2. No cover applies under this section to any treatment that happens within the first 90 days after the policy start date.
18.3. The most we will pay for Major restorative work under this section is $500 per treatment.
18.4. The most we will pay for Orthodontics under this section is $600 per treatment.
18.5. We will not pay for treatment that is mainly cosmetic, such as whitening or veneers. This exclusion does not apply to treatment needed to repair damage caused by an accident.
18.6. We will not pay for treatment by a provider outside the plan's network. This exclusion does not apply to emergency treatment for sudden severe pain.

19. General exclusions
19.1. We will not pay for loss of value or loss of use that does not involve physical loss or damage.
19.2. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
19.3. We will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits us from paying.
19.4. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
19.5. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
19.6. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.

20. Customer support
20.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
20.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

21. Making a claim
21.1. You must notify us of a claim within 60 days of the treatment. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.
21.2. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
21.3. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.

22. Automatic renewal
22.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
22.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

23. Payment of claims
23.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.

3. Accessibility

4.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
4.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 15 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

6.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

7.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

8.2. No cover applies under this section to any incident that happens within the first 14 days after the policy start date.

9. Exchange of information
9.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
9.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

10. Interest
10.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

11. General exclusions
11.1. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
11.2. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
11.3. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.

12. Missed departure
12.1. We will pay reasonable additional travel and accommodation costs to reach your destination if you arrive too late to board your booked transport because public transport fails.
12.2. You must allow enough time to reach the departure point, and must obtain written confirmation of the delay from the transport operator.

13.1. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the meaning of this policy.
13.2. Words in the singular include the plural and the other way round.
13.3. Words defined in the definitions section have the same meaning wherever they appear in bold or with an initial capital.

14. Sanctions
14.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

15. Records and evidence
15.1. You should keep receipts, photographs and valuations for items of significant value.
15.2. Where proof of value is missing, we may base any settlement on the price of a comparable item.
15.3. We may ask for evidence of how and when an item was acquired.

16. How to read this document
16.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
16.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
16.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

17. Customer support
17.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
17.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

18. Personal liability
18.1. We will pay damages you become legally liable to pay for accidental injury to another person or accidental damage to their property during the trip.
18.2. This section does not cover liability arising from the use of motor vehicles, boats or aircraft.
18.3. The most we will pay under this section is $2,000,000 for all claims arising from one event.

19.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.

22.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

1.18. Schedule means the document issued with this policy that shows your details, the covers you bought and any extensions.
1.19. Unoccupied means not lived in by you or a member of your family for more than 45 consecutive days.

2. Limits and excess
2.1. Theft: limit $10,000 per incident; excess $100 per claim.
2.2. Escape of Water: limit $15,000 per incident; excess $500 per claim.
2.3. Accidental Damage: limit $2,000 per incident; excess $100 per claim.
2.4. Flood: limit $40,000 per incident; excess $500 per claim.
2.5. Any limit or sublimit is applied to the assessed loss first, and the excess is then deducted from the result.

3. Arbitration
3.1. If we accept a claim but disagree with you about the amount, the difference will be referred to an arbitrator appointed by both parties.
3.2. Where arbitration applies, obtaining an award is a condition precedent to any legal action against us.

4. Interpretation
4.1. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the meaning of this policy.
4.2. Words in the singular include the plural and the other way round.
4.3. Words defined in the definitions section have the same meaning wherever they appear in bold or with an initial capital.

5. Records and evidence
5.1. You should keep receipts, photographs and valuations for items of significant value.
5.2. Where proof of value is missing, we may base any settlement on the price of a comparable item.
5.3. We may ask for evidence of how and when an item was acquired.

6. Tenant's improvements
6.1. If you rent the home, we will pay for damage to fixtures and fittings that you installed and are responsible for.
6.2. This cover applies only to improvements you paid for, not to items provided by the landlord.

7. Data protection
7.1. We will use the personal information you provide to administer this policy and to handle claims.
7.2. We will keep personal information only for as long as it is needed for these purposes or as required by law.
7.3. You can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold by writing to our data protection officer.

8. Environmental commitment
8.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
8.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

9. Locks and keys
9.1. If the keys to your home are lost or stolen, we will pay the cost of replacing the locks to the outside doors.
9.2. The most we will pay under this clause is $750 for any one claim.

10. Third-party administrators
10.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.
10.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

11. Optional cover: Accidental Damage
11.1. We will pay for sudden and unexpected accidental damage to your contents inside the home.
11.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
11.3. The most we will pay for Portable electronics under this section is $750 per incident.
11.4. We will not pay for damage caused by pets.
11.5. We will not pay for wear and tear, or damage that happens gradually.

12. Instalment agreements
12.1. If you pay by instalments, the instalment agreement is a separate contract with the finance provider.
12.2. Ending the instalment agreement does not cancel this policy, but unpaid premium remains due.

13. Severability
13.1. If any term of this policy is found to be invalid, the remaining terms will continue in full force.

14. Accessibility
14.1. This document is available in large print, braille or audio on request.

15. Duty of fair presentation
15.1. You must answer all questions we ask honestly and to the best of your knowledge.
15.2. If you give incorrect information deliberately or recklessly, we may treat this policy as if it never existed and keep the premium.
15.3. If you give incorrect information carelessly, we may reduce any claim payment in proportion to the premium that should have been charged.

16. Cancellation
16.1. You can cancel this policy within 14 days of receiving it and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made.
16.2. After the first 14 days you can cancel at any time; we will refund the premium for the unexpired period less an administration charge of $25.
16.3. We can cancel this policy by giving you 30 days' written notice to the last address we hold.

17. Taxes
17.1. The premium includes any insurance premium tax at the current rate.
17.2. If the tax rate changes, we may adjust the premium from the date of the change.

18. Notices
18.1. Any notice we give under this policy will be sent to the most recent postal or email address we hold.
18.2. Notices from you should be sent to the address shown in the schedule.

19. Freezer contents
19.1. We will pay for food in a domestic freezer that spoils because of a rise or fall in temperature.
19.2. We will not pay if the freezer is more than fifteen years old, or if the electricity supplier cut the supply deliberately.

20. Discounts
20.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
20.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

21. Assignment
21.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

22. Communication
22.1. We will communicate with you in English.
22.2. We may record telephone calls for training and quality purposes.

23. Claims documents
23.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.
23.2. We may ask for a medical certificate, a police report or a repair estimate, depending on the claim.

24. Alternative accommodation
24.1. If your home cannot be lived in after damage covered by this policy, we will pay the reasonable cost of comparable temporary accommodation.
24.2. We will also pay for the temporary housing of pets that live with you.
24.3. Cover ends when the home is fit to live in again or after twelve months, whichever is sooner.

25. Payment of claims
25.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
25.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 10 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

26. Electronic documents
26.1. We will send documents by email unless you ask for paper copies.
26.2. You must tell us if your email address changes.
26.3. Documents sent by email are treated as received on the day they are sent.

27. Reasonable precautions
27.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
27.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

28. Premium payment
28.1. You must pay the premium on or before the policy start date or in the monthly instalments shown in the schedule.
28.2. If an instalment is not paid within 21 days of its due date, we may cancel the policy after giving notice.

29. Geographical limits
29.1. Cover applies only within the territory shown in the schedule.
29.2. Cover for property temporarily away from its usual place applies only within the same country.

30. Customer support
30.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
30.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

31. Subrogation
31.1. We will be entitled to take over and conduct in your name the defence or settlement of any claim.
31.2. We can take action in your name to recover any payment we make from anyone responsible for the loss.

32. Salvage
32.1. When we replace an item, the damaged or recovered item becomes our property.
32.2. If stolen property is recovered after we have paid a claim, you must tell us and either return the payment or give us the property.

33. Flood
33.1. We will pay for contents damaged by flood water entering your home.
33.2. No cover applies under this section to any incident that happens within the first 60 days after the policy start date.
33.3. The most we will pay for Garden items under this section is $500 per incident.
33.4. We will not pay for flood damage where a flood warning for your area had been issued before the policy started.

34. Fraud
34.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.
34.2. We may share information with fraud prevention agencies and other insurers.

35. Change of address
35.1. You must tell us within 30 days if you change your address.
35.2. We may change the premium or the terms from the date of the move.

36. Cooperation
36.1. You must give us all the help and information we reasonably need to settle a claim.
36.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

37. Governing law
37.1. This policy is governed by the law of the jurisdiction in which it was issued, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.
37.2. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of that jurisdiction.

38. Exchange of information
38.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
38.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

39. Garden and outdoor cover
39.1. We will pay for plants, trees and shrubs in the garden of the home that are damaged by fire, lightning or theft.
39.2. We will not pay for damage caused by frost, storms, drought or animals.

40. Joint policyholders
40.1. Where more than one person is named in the schedule, each of them is treated as having knowledge of anything any of them knows.
40.2. A notice sent to one named person is treated as sent to all of them.

41. How to read this document
41.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
41.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
41.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

42. Waiver
42.1. If we do not enforce any term of this policy, that does not mean we have given up the right to enforce it later.

43. Complaints
43.1. If you have a complaint, you should first contact our customer relations team, quoting the policy number.
43.2. We will acknowledge a complaint within five working days and aim to resolve it within eight weeks.
43.3. If you remain dissatisfied, you may be able to refer the complaint to an independent ombudsman service.

44. Theft
44.1. We will pay for contents stolen from your home.
44.2. The most we will pay for High-risk items under this section is $1,500 per incident.
44.3. The most we will pay for Bicycles under this section is $800 per incident.
44.4. We will not pay for theft while the home is unoccupied.
44.5. We will not pay for theft where there is no sign of forced entry to the home. This exclusion does not apply where the thief gained entry by deception, for example by posing as a utility worker.
44.6. We will not pay for theft from sheds, garages or other outbuildings. This exclusion does not apply if the outbuilding was locked and the theft involved forcible entry.

45. Contents temporarily removed
45.1. Your contents are covered while temporarily removed from the home to another building in the same country, for up to 60 days.
45.2. Contents in a student hall of residence are covered only if the student is a member of your family.

46. Interest
46.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

47. Escape of Water
47.1. We will pay for contents damaged by water escaping from a fixed pipe, tank or domestic appliance.
47.2. The most we will pay for Art and antiques under this section is $2,000 per incident.
47.3. We will not pay for damage caused by water leaking gradually over a period of time.
47.4. We will not pay for damage caused by the failure of grout or sealant around baths and showers.

48. Sanctions
48.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

49. Compensation scheme
49.1. We are covered by a financial services compensation scheme.
49.2. If we cannot meet our obligations, you may be entitled to compensation from the scheme, depending on the type of policy and the circumstances.

50. Automatic renewal
50.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
50.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

51. General exclusions
51.1. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.
51.2. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
51.3. We will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits us from paying.
51.4. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
51.5. We will not pay for loss of value or loss of use that does not involve physical loss or damage.
51.6. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.

52. Renewal
52.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.
52.2. We are not obliged to offer renewal.

53. Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
53.1. A person who is not a party to this policy has no right to enforce any of its terms.

54. Other insurance
54.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
54.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

55. Changes in circumstances
55.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.
55.2. We may then change the premium or the terms of this policy, or cancel it.

56. Recovery of costs
56.1. If we pay a claim that is later found not to be covered, we may ask you to repay the amount.

57. Market conditions
57.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

58. Making a claim
58.1. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
58.2. You must notify us of a claim within 14 days of the incident. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.
58.3. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.

59. Inflation
59.1. We may adjust limits at renewal in line with a published index of consumer prices.
59.2. Any adjustment will be shown in your renewal documents; limits do not change during a policy period.

60. Currency
60.1. All amounts in this policy are in US dollars.
60.2. Claims for costs incurred in another currency will be converted at the exchange rate on the date the cost was incurred.

15.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

16.1. We will communicate with you in English.
16.2. We may record telephone calls for training and quality purposes.

17.1. You should keep receipts, photographs and valuations for items of significant value.

19.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

20. Repair process
20.1. After a claim is accepted, we will send a prepaid mailer or book a courier collection.
20.2. We aim to return repaired devices within 15 business days of receiving them.

21. Unrecoverable devices
21.1. If a device is found after we have replaced it, the found device becomes our property and must be sent to us.
21.2. We may block devices reported as lost or stolen so that they cannot be used on mobile networks.

22. Inflation
22.1. We may adjust limits at renewal in line with a published index of consumer prices.
22.2. Any adjustment will be shown in your renewal documents; limits do not change during a policy period.

23. Currency
23.1. All amounts in this policy are in US dollars.
23.2. Claims for costs incurred in another currency will be converted at the exchange rate on the date the cost was incurred.

24. Interpretation
24.1. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the meaning of this policy.
24.2. Words in the singular include the plural and the other way round.
24.3. Words defined in the definitions section have the same meaning wherever they appear in bold or with an initial capital.

25. Market conditions
25.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

26. Customer support
26.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
26.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

27. Payment of claims
27.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
27.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 15 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

EMPLOYEE HEALTH BENEFITS PLAN: SUMMARY PLAN DESCRIPTION
Issued by Synthetic Policy Office 1

1. Definitions
1.1. Assessed loss means the cost of repair or replacement agreed by us, before any deductible, limit or sublimit is applied.
1.2. Family means your spouse or partner and any children who live with you.
1.3. Frames means spectacle frames bought without new lenses.
1.4. Hearing accessories means batteries, chargers and cleaning kits.
1.5. Hearing aid replacement period means 24 months from the purchase of hearing aids funded by the plan.
1.6. Incident means a single event, or a series of events arising from one cause.
1.7. Limit means the most we will pay for all claims under a section arising from one treatment.
1.8. Major restorative work means crowns, bridges, root canal treatment and implants.
1.9. Massage therapy means sports massage, massage therapy and reflexology.
1.10. Network provider means a practitioner or clinic that has an agreement with us to provide treatment.
1.11. Orthodontics means braces and clear aligners.
1.12. Plan year means the twelve months starting on your coverage start date.
1.13. Policy period means twelve months from the policy start date shown in your schedule.
1.14. Premium means the amount you must pay for this policy, including any taxes.
1.15. Replacement period means 12 months from the date of your last eyewear claim.

2. Limits and deductible
2.1. Dental Care: limit $1,500 per treatment; deductible $100 per claim.
2.2. Vision Care: limit $500 per treatment; deductible $40 per claim.
2.3. Therapy Services: limit $1,500 per treatment; deductible $50 per claim.
2.4. Hearing Care: limit $1,000 per treatment; deductible $150 per claim.
2.5. Any limit or sublimit is applied to the assessed loss first, and the deductible is then deducted from the result.

3. Inflation
3.1. We may adjust limits at renewal in line with a published index of consumer prices.
3.2. Any adjustment will be shown in your renewal documents; limits do not change during a policy period.

4. Change of address
4.1. You must tell us within 30 days if you change your address.
4.2. We may change the premium or the terms from the date of the move.

5. Fraud
5.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.
5.2. We may share information with fraud prevention agencies and other insurers.

6. Renewal
6.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.
6.2. We are not obliged to offer renewal.

7. Recovery of costs
7.1. If we pay a claim that is later found not to be covered, we may ask you to repay the amount.

8. Interest
8.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

9. Eligibility
9.1. Employees who work at least 20 hours a week are eligible to join the plan from their first day of employment.
9.2. Contractors, agency workers and employees on unpaid leave of more than three months are not eligible.

10. Therapy Services
10.1. We will reimburse physiotherapy, osteopathy and counselling provided by a registered practitioner.
10.2. The most we will pay for Massage therapy under this section is $200 per treatment.
10.3. We will not pay for treatment of an injury covered by workers' compensation.
10.4. We will not pay for treatment by a practitioner who is not registered with the relevant professional body.

11. Premium payment
11.1. You must pay the premium on or before the policy start date or in the monthly instalments shown in the schedule.
11.2. If an instalment is not paid within 14 days of its due date, we may cancel the policy after giving notice.

12. Discounts
12.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
12.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

13. Salvage
13.1. When we replace an item, the damaged or recovered item becomes our property.
13.2. If stolen property is recovered after we have paid a claim, you must tell us and either return the payment or give us the property.

14. Governing law
14.1. This policy is governed by the law of the jurisdiction in which it was issued, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.
14.2. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of that jurisdiction.

15. Optional cover: Hearing Care
15.1. We will reimburse hearing tests and hearing aids.
15.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
15.3. The most we will pay for Hearing accessories under this section is $150 per treatment.
15.4. We will not pay for replacement hearing aids bought within the hearing aid replacement period.

16. Assignment
16.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

17. Severability
17.1. If any term of this policy is found to be invalid, the remaining terms will continue in full force.

18. Subrogation
18.1. We will be entitled to take over and conduct in your name the defence or settlement of any claim.
18.2. We can take action in your name to recover any payment we make from anyone responsible for the loss.

19. Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
19.1. A person who is not a party to this policy has no right to enforce any of its terms.

20. Vision Care
20.1. We will reimburse eye tests and prescription eyewear.
20.2. The most we will pay for Frames under this section is $150 per treatment.
20.3. We will not pay for eyewear without prescription lenses.
20.4. We will not pay for a further eyewear claim within the replacement period.

21. Dependants
21.1. You may enrol dependants at the start of each plan year or within 30 days of a qualifying life event.
21.2. Benefits paid for dependants count towards the same annual limits as your own claims.

22. Changes in circumstances
22.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.
22.2. We may then change the premium or the terms of this policy, or cancel it.

23. Environmental commitment
23.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
23.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

24. Reasonable precautions
24.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
24.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

25. Other insurance
25.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
25.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

26. Sanctions
26.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

27. Currency
27.1. All amounts in this policy are in US dollars.
27.2. Claims for costs incurred in another currency will be converted at the exchange rate on the date the cost was incurred.

28. Leaving the plan
28.1. Cover ends on the day your employment ends or the day you stop being eligible, whichever is earlier.
28.2. Claims for treatment received before cover ended may be submitted up to 90 days afterwards.

29. Arbitration
29.1. If we accept a claim but disagree with you about the amount, the difference will be referred to an arbitrator appointed by both parties.
29.2. Where arbitration applies, obtaining an award is a condition precedent to any legal action against us.

30. Notices
30.1. Any notice we give under this policy will be sent to the most recent postal or email address we hold.
30.2. Notices from you should be sent to the address shown in the schedule.

31. Waiver
31.1. If we do not enforce any term of this policy, that does not mean we have given up the right to enforce it later.

32. Appeals
32.1. If we decline all or part of a claim, you may appeal in writing within 60 days of the decision.
32.2. An appeal will be reviewed by someone who was not involved in the original decision.
32.3. We will give you a written decision on the appeal within 30 days.

33. Dental Care
33.1. We will reimburse the cost of dental treatment provided by a licensed dentist.
33.2. No cover applies under this section to any treatment that happens within the first 60 days after the policy start date.
33.3. The most we will pay for Major restorative work under this section is $750 per treatment.
33.4. The most we will pay for Orthodontics under this section is $600 per treatment.
33.5. We will not pay for treatment that is mainly cosmetic, such as whitening or veneers. This exclusion does not apply to treatment needed to repair damage caused by an accident.
33.6. We will not pay for treatment by a provider outside the plan's network. This exclusion does not apply to emergency treatment for sudden severe pain.

34. How to read this document
34.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
34.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
34.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

35. Coordination of benefits
35.1. If a treatment is also covered by another plan, we will pay only the part of the cost that the other plan does not pay.
35.2. You must tell us about any other plan that covers you or your dependants.

36. General exclusions
36.1. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
36.2. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
36.3. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
36.4. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.
36.5. We will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits us from paying.

37. Cooperation
37.1. You must give us all the help and information we reasonably need to settle a claim.
37.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

38. Compensation scheme
38.1. We are covered by a financial services compensation scheme.
38.2. If we cannot meet our obligations, you may be entitled to compensation from the scheme, depending on the type of policy and the circumstances.

39. Geographical limits
39.1. Cover applies only within the territory shown in the schedule.
39.2. Cover for property temporarily away from its usual place applies only within the same country.

40. Customer support
40.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
40.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

41. Payment of claims
41.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
41.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 5 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

42. Automatic renewal
42.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
42.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

43. Third-party administrators
43.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.
43.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

44. Electronic documents
44.1. We will send documents by email unless you ask for paper copies.
44.2. You must tell us if your email address changes.
44.3. Documents sent by email are treated as received on the day they are sent.

45. Making a claim
45.1. You must notify us of a claim within 60 days of the treatment. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.
45.2. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.
45.3. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.

46. Joint policyholders
46.1. Where more than one person is named in the schedule, each of them is treated as having knowledge of anything any of them knows.
46.2. A notice sent to one named person is treated as sent to all of them.
