EMPLOYEE HEALTH BENEFITS PLAN: SUMMARY PLAN DESCRIPTION
Issued by Synthetic Policy Office 1

1. Definitions
1.1. Assessed loss means the cost of repair or replacement agreed by us, before any deductible, limit or sublimit is applied.
1.2. Business day means Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays.
1.3. Dependant means your spouse or partner, or a child under 21 who is enrolled in the plan.
1.4. Family means your spouse or partner and any children who live with you.
1.5. Frames means spectacle frames bought without new lenses.
1.6. Hearing accessories means batteries, chargers and cleaning kits.
1.7. Hearing aid replacement period means 36 months from the purchase of hearing aids funded by the plan.
1.8. Incident means a single event, or a series of events arising from one cause.
1.9. Limit means the most we will pay for all claims under a section arising from one treatment.
1.10. Major restorative work means crowns, bridges, root canal treatment and implants.
1.11. Massage therapy means sports massage, massage therapy and reflexology.
1.12. Orthodontics means braces and clear aligners.
1.13. Plan year means the twelve months starting on your coverage start date.
1.14. Receipt means a document from the seller or provider showing the date, the amount paid and what was supplied.
1.15. Replacement period means 24 months from the date of your last eyewear claim.
1.16. Schedule means the document issued with this policy that shows your details, the covers you bought and any extensions.
1.17. Sublimit means a lower limit that applies to a particular class of property or treatment within a section.

2. Limits and deductible
2.1. Dental Care: limit $2,000 per treatment; deductible $100 per claim.
2.2. Vision Care: limit $400 per treatment; deductible $40 per claim.
2.3. Therapy Services: limit $1,000 per treatment; deductible $50 per claim.
2.4. Hearing Care: limit $2,000 per treatment; deductible $150 per claim.
2.5. Any limit or sublimit is applied to the assessed loss first, and the deductible is then deducted from the result.

3. Arbitration
3.1. If we accept a claim but disagree with you about the amount, the difference will be referred to an arbitrator appointed by both parties.
3.2. Where arbitration applies, obtaining an award is a condition precedent to any legal action against us.

4. Complaints
4.1. If you have a complaint, you should first contact our customer relations team, quoting the policy number.
4.2. We will acknowledge a complaint within five working days and aim to resolve it within eight weeks.
4.3. If you remain dissatisfied, you may be able to refer the complaint to an independent ombudsman service.

5. Market conditions
5.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

6. Environmental commitment
6.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
6.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

7. Cooperation
7.1. You must give us all the help and information we reasonably need to settle a claim.
7.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

8. Instalment agreements
8.1. If you pay by instalments, the instalment agreement is a separate contract with the finance provider.
8.2. Ending the instalment agreement does not cancel this policy, but unpaid premium remains due.

9. Coordination of benefits
9.1. If a treatment is also covered by another plan, we will pay only the part of the cost that the other plan does not pay.
9.2. You must tell us about any other plan that covers you or your dependants.

10. Change of address
10.1. You must tell us within 30 days if you change your address.
10.2. We may change the premium or the terms from the date of the move.

11. Dental Care
11.1. We will reimburse the cost of dental treatment provided by a licensed dentist.
11.2. No cover applies under this section to any treatment that happens within the first 90 days after the policy start date.
11.3. The most we will pay for Major restorative work under this section is $750 per treatment.
11.4. The most we will pay for Orthodontics under this section is $600 per treatment.
11.5. We will not pay for treatment that is mainly cosmetic, such as whitening or veneers. This exclusion does not apply to treatment needed to repair damage caused by an accident.
11.6. We will not pay for treatment by a provider outside the plan's network. This exclusion does not apply to emergency treatment for sudden severe pain.

12. Appeals
12.1. If we decline all or part of a claim, you may appeal in writing within 60 days of the decision.
12.2. An appeal will be reviewed by someone who was not involved in the original decision.
12.3. We will give you a written decision on the appeal within 30 days.

13. Waiver
13.1. If we do not enforce any term of this policy, that does not mean we have given up the right to enforce it later.

14. Notices
14.1. Any notice we give under this policy will be sent to the most recent postal or email address we hold.
14.2. Notices from you should be sent to the address shown in the schedule.

15. Wellness allowance
15.1. Each plan year you may claim up to $100 towards a gym membership or fitness class.
15.2. The wellness allowance is not subject to any deductible and does not count towards other limits.

16. Changes in circumstances
16.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.
16.2. We may then change the premium or the terms of this policy, or cancel it.

17. Exchange of information
17.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
17.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

18. Leaving the plan
18.1. Cover ends on the day your employment ends or the day you stop being eligible, whichever is earlier.
18.2. Claims for treatment received before cover ended may be submitted up to 90 days afterwards.

19. Compensation scheme
19.1. We are covered by a financial services compensation scheme.
19.2. If we cannot meet our obligations, you may be entitled to compensation from the scheme, depending on the type of policy and the circumstances.

20. Severability
20.1. If any term of this policy is found to be invalid, the remaining terms will continue in full force.

21. Currency
21.1. All amounts in this policy are in US dollars.
21.2. Claims for costs incurred in another currency will be converted at the exchange rate on the date the cost was incurred.

22. Cancellation
22.1. You can cancel this policy within 14 days of receiving it and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made.
22.2. After the first 14 days you can cancel at any time; we will refund the premium for the unexpired period less an administration charge of $30.
22.3. We can cancel this policy by giving you 30 days' written notice to the last address we hold.

23. Subrogation
23.1. We will be entitled to take over and conduct in your name the defence or settlement of any claim.
23.2. We can take action in your name to recover any payment we make from anyone responsible for the loss.

24. Accessibility
24.1. This document is available in large print, braille or audio on request.

25. Interest
25.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

26. Claims documents
26.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.
26.2. We may ask for a medical certificate, a police report or a repair estimate, depending on the claim.

27. Geographical limits
27.1. Cover applies only within the territory shown in the schedule.
27.2. Cover for property temporarily away from its usual place applies only within the same country.

28. Taxes
28.1. The premium includes any insurance premium tax at the current rate.
28.2. If the tax rate changes, we may adjust the premium from the date of the change.

29. How to read this document
29.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
29.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
29.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

30. Sanctions
30.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

31. Third-party administrators
31.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.
31.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

32. Eligibility
32.1. Employees who work at least 20 hours a week are eligible to join the plan from their first day of employment.
32.2. Contractors, agency workers and employees on unpaid leave of more than three months are not eligible.

33. Optional cover: Hearing Care
33.1. We will reimburse hearing tests and hearing aids.
33.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
33.3. The most we will pay for Hearing accessories under this section is $150 per treatment.
33.4. We will not pay for replacement hearing aids bought within the hearing aid replacement period.

34. Records and evidence
34.1. You should keep receipts, photographs and valuations for items of significant value.
34.2. Where proof of value is missing, we may base any settlement on the price of a comparable item.
34.3. We may ask for evidence of how and when an item was acquired.

35. Therapy Services
35.1. We will reimburse physiotherapy, osteopathy and counselling provided by a registered practitioner.
35.2. The most we will pay for Massage therapy under this section is $200 per treatment.
35.3. We will not pay for treatment of an injury covered by workers' compensation.
35.4. We will not pay for treatment by a practitioner who is not registered with the relevant professional body.

36. Vision Care
36.1. We will reimburse eye tests and prescription eyewear.
36.2. The most we will pay for Frames under this section is $150 per treatment.
36.3. We will not pay for eyewear without prescription lenses.
36.4. We will not pay for a further eyewear claim within the replacement period.

37. Automatic renewal
37.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
37.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

38. Reasonable precautions
38.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
38.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

39. Payment of claims
39.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
39.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 10 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

40. Data protection
40.1. We will use the personal information you provide to administer this policy and to handle claims.
40.2. We will keep personal information only for as long as it is needed for these purposes or as required by law.
40.3. You can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold by writing to our data protection officer.

41. Salvage
41.1. When we replace an item, the damaged or recovered item becomes our property.
41.2. If stolen property is recovered after we have paid a claim, you must tell us and either return the payment or give us the property.

42. General exclusions
42.1. We will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits us from paying.
42.2. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
42.3. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
42.4. We will not pay for loss of value or loss of use that does not involve physical loss or damage.
42.5. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.

43. Recovery of costs
43.1. If we pay a claim that is later found not to be covered, we may ask you to repay the amount.

44. Governing law
44.1. This policy is governed by the law of the jurisdiction in which it was issued, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.
44.2. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of that jurisdiction.

45. Duty of fair presentation
45.1. You must answer all questions we ask honestly and to the best of your knowledge.
45.2. If you give incorrect information deliberately or recklessly, we may treat this policy as if it never existed and keep the premium.
45.3. If you give incorrect information carelessly, we may reduce any claim payment in proportion to the premium that should have been charged.

46. Communication
46.1. We will communicate with you in English.
46.2. We may record telephone calls for training and quality purposes.

47. Making a claim
47.1. You must notify us of a claim within 60 days of the treatment. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.
47.2. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
47.3. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.

48. Dependants
48.1. You may enrol dependants at the start of each plan year or within 30 days of a qualifying life event.
48.2. Benefits paid for dependants count towards the same annual limits as your own claims.

49. Inflation
49.1. We may adjust limits at renewal in line with a published index of consumer prices.
49.2. Any adjustment will be shown in your renewal documents; limits do not change during a policy period.

50. Premium payment
50.1. You must pay the premium on or before the policy start date or in the monthly instalments shown in the schedule.
50.2. If an instalment is not paid within 14 days of its due date, we may cancel the policy after giving notice.

51. Other insurance
51.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
51.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

52. Discounts
52.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
52.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

53. Interpretation
53.1. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the meaning of this policy.
53.2. Words in the singular include the plural and the other way round.
53.3. Words defined in the definitions section have the same meaning wherever they appear in bold or with an initial capital.

54. Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
54.1. A person who is not a party to this policy has no right to enforce any of its terms.

55. Joint policyholders
55.1. Where more than one person is named in the schedule, each of them is treated as having knowledge of anything any of them knows.
55.2. A notice sent to one named person is treated as sent to all of them.

56. Fraud
56.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.
56.2. We may share information with fraud prevention agencies and other insurers.

57. Customer support
57.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
57.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

58. Electronic documents
58.1. We will send documents by email unless you ask for paper copies.
58.2. You must tell us if your email address changes.
58.3. Documents sent by email are treated as received on the day they are sent.

59. Assignment
59.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

60. Renewal
60.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.
60.2. We are not obliged to offer renewal.

GROUP HEALTH CASH PLAN
Issued by Synthetic Policy Office 1

1. Definitions
1.1. Family means your spouse or partner and any children who live with you.
1.2. Frames means spectacle frames bought without new lenses.
1.3. Hearing accessories means batteries, chargers and cleaning kits.
1.4. Hearing aid replacement period means 36 months from the purchase of hearing aids funded by the plan.
1.5. Major restorative work means crowns, bridges, root canal treatment and implants.
1.6. Massage therapy means sports massage, massage therapy and reflexology.
1.7. Orthodontics means braces and clear aligners.
1.8. Policy period means twelve months from the policy start date shown in your schedule.
1.9. Premium means the amount you must pay for this policy, including any taxes.
1.10. Proof of purchase means an original receipt, invoice or bank statement showing the item, the price and the date.
1.11. Receipt means a document from the seller or provider showing the date, the amount paid and what was supplied.
1.12. Registered practitioner means a practitioner registered with the professional body for their discipline.
1.13. Replacement period means 24 months from the date of your last eyewear claim.

2. Limits and deductible
2.1. Dental Care: limit $1,500 per treatment; deductible $50 per claim.
2.2. Vision Care: limit $300 per treatment; deductible $40 per claim.
2.3. Therapy Services: limit $1,500 per treatment; deductible $50 per claim.
2.4. Hearing Care: limit $1,000 per treatment; deductible $150 per claim.
2.5. Any limit or sublimit is applied to the assessed loss first, and the deductible is then deducted from the result.

3. Coordination of benefits
3.1. If a treatment is also covered by another plan, we will pay only the part of the cost that the other plan does not pay.
3.2. You must tell us about any other plan that covers you or your dependants.

4. Optional cover: Hearing Care
4.1. We will reimburse hearing tests and hearing aids.
4.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
4.3. The most we will pay for Hearing accessories under this section is $150 per treatment.
4.4. We will not pay for replacement hearing aids bought within the hearing aid replacement period.

5. Reasonable precautions
5.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
5.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

6. Cancellation
6.1. You can cancel this policy within 14 days of receiving it and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made.
6.2. After the first 14 days you can cancel at any time; we will refund the premium for the unexpired period less an administration charge of $30.
6.3. We can cancel this policy by giving you 30 days' written notice to the last address we hold.

7. Complaints
7.1. If you have a complaint, you should first contact our customer relations team, quoting the policy number.
7.2. We will acknowledge a complaint within five working days and aim to resolve it within eight weeks.
7.3. If you remain dissatisfied, you may be able to refer the complaint to an independent ombudsman service.

8. Compensation scheme
8.1. We are covered by a financial services compensation scheme.
8.2. If we cannot meet our obligations, you may be entitled to compensation from the scheme, depending on the type of policy and the circumstances.

9. Other insurance
9.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
9.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

10. Exchange of information
10.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
10.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

11. Therapy Services
11.1. We will reimburse physiotherapy, osteopathy and counselling provided by a registered practitioner.
11.2. The most we will pay for Massage therapy under this section is $200 per treatment.
11.3. We will not pay for treatment of an injury covered by workers' compensation.
11.4. We will not pay for treatment by a practitioner who is not registered with the relevant professional body.

12. Communication
12.1. We will communicate with you in English.
12.2. We may record telephone calls for training and quality purposes.

13. Renewal
13.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.
13.2. We are not obliged to offer renewal.

14. Salvage
14.1. When we replace an item, the damaged or recovered item becomes our property.
14.2. If stolen property is recovered after we have paid a claim, you must tell us and either return the payment or give us the property.

15. Appeals
15.1. If we decline all or part of a claim, you may appeal in writing within 60 days of the decision.
15.2. An appeal will be reviewed by someone who was not involved in the original decision.
15.3. We will give you a written decision on the appeal within 30 days.

16. Vision Care
16.1. We will reimburse eye tests and prescription eyewear.
16.2. The most we will pay for Frames under this section is $120 per treatment.
16.3. We will not pay for eyewear without prescription lenses.
16.4. We will not pay for a further eyewear claim within the replacement period.

17. Fraud
17.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.
17.2. We may share information with fraud prevention agencies and other insurers.

18. Interest
18.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

19. Market conditions
19.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

20. Recovery of costs
20.1. If we pay a claim that is later found not to be covered, we may ask you to repay the amount.

21. Inflation
21.1. We may adjust limits at renewal in line with a published index of consumer prices.
21.2. Any adjustment will be shown in your renewal documents; limits do not change during a policy period.

22. Data protection
22.1. We will use the personal information you provide to administer this policy and to handle claims.
22.2. We will keep personal information only for as long as it is needed for these purposes or as required by law.
22.3. You can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold by writing to our data protection officer.

23. Dependants
23.1. You may enrol dependants at the start of each plan year or within 30 days of a qualifying life event.
23.2. Benefits paid for dependants count towards the same annual limits as your own claims.

24. Dental Care
24.1. We will reimburse the cost of dental treatment provided by a licensed dentist.
24.2. No cover applies under this section to any treatment that happens within the first 90 days after the policy start date.
24.3. The most we will pay for Major restorative work under this section is $500 per treatment.
24.4. The most we will pay for Orthodontics under this section is $800 per treatment.
24.5. We will not pay for treatment that is mainly cosmetic, such as whitening or veneers. This exclusion does not apply to treatment needed to repair damage caused by an accident.
24.6. We will not pay for treatment by a provider outside the plan's network. This exclusion does not apply to emergency treatment for sudden severe pain.

25. Subrogation
25.1. We will be entitled to take over and conduct in your name the defence or settlement of any claim.
25.2. We can take action in your name to recover any payment we make from anyone responsible for the loss.

26. Customer support
26.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
26.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

27. Accessibility
27.1. This document is available in large print, braille or audio on request.

28. Interpretation
28.1. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the meaning of this policy.
28.2. Words in the singular include the plural and the other way round.
28.3. Words defined in the definitions section have the same meaning wherever they appear in bold or with an initial capital.

29. Leaving the plan
29.1. Cover ends on the day your employment ends or the day you stop being eligible, whichever is earlier.
29.2. Claims for treatment received before cover ended may be submitted up to 90 days afterwards.

30. Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
30.1. A person who is not a party to this policy has no right to enforce any of its terms.

31. Electronic documents
31.1. We will send documents by email unless you ask for paper copies.
31.2. You must tell us if your email address changes.
31.3. Documents sent by email are treated as received on the day they are sent.

32. Discounts
32.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
32.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

33. Changes in circumstances
33.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.
33.2. We may then change the premium or the terms of this policy, or cancel it.

34. Eligibility
34.1. Employees who work at least 20 hours a week are eligible to join the plan from their first day of employment.
34.2. Contractors, agency workers and employees on unpaid leave of more than three months are not eligible.

35. Currency
35.1. All amounts in this policy are in US dollars.
35.2. Claims for costs incurred in another currency will be converted at the exchange rate on the date the cost was incurred.

36. General exclusions
36.1. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
36.2. We will not pay for loss of value or loss of use that does not involve physical loss or damage.
36.3. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
36.4. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.
36.5. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
36.6. We will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits us from paying.

37. Records and evidence
37.1. You should keep receipts, photographs and valuations for items of significant value.
37.2. Where proof of value is missing, we may base any settlement on the price of a comparable item.
37.3. We may ask for evidence of how and when an item was acquired.

38. Third-party administrators
38.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.
38.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

39. Making a claim
39.1. You must notify us of a claim within 90 days of the treatment. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.
39.2. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
39.3. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.

40. Duty of fair presentation
40.1. You must answer all questions we ask honestly and to the best of your knowledge.
40.2. If you give incorrect information deliberately or recklessly, we may treat this policy as if it never existed and keep the premium.
40.3. If you give incorrect information carelessly, we may reduce any claim payment in proportion to the premium that should have been charged.

41. Arbitration
41.1. If we accept a claim but disagree with you about the amount, the difference will be referred to an arbitrator appointed by both parties.
41.2. Where arbitration applies, obtaining an award is a condition precedent to any legal action against us.

42. Wellness allowance
42.1. Each plan year you may claim up to $250 towards a gym membership or fitness class.
42.2. The wellness allowance is not subject to any deductible and does not count towards other limits.

43. Taxes
43.1. The premium includes any insurance premium tax at the current rate.
43.2. If the tax rate changes, we may adjust the premium from the date of the change.

44. Payment of claims
44.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
44.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 10 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

45. Instalment agreements
45.1. If you pay by instalments, the instalment agreement is a separate contract with the finance provider.
45.2. Ending the instalment agreement does not cancel this policy, but unpaid premium remains due.

46. Joint policyholders
46.1. Where more than one person is named in the schedule, each of them is treated as having knowledge of anything any of them knows.
46.2. A notice sent to one named person is treated as sent to all of them.

47. Sanctions
47.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

48. Waiver
48.1. If we do not enforce any term of this policy, that does not mean we have given up the right to enforce it later.

49. Environmental commitment
49.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
49.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

50. Governing law
50.1. This policy is governed by the law of the jurisdiction in which it was issued, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.
50.2. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of that jurisdiction.

51. Claims documents
51.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.
51.2. We may ask for a medical certificate, a police report or a repair estimate, depending on the claim.

52. How to read this document
52.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
52.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
52.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

53. Cooperation
53.1. You must give us all the help and information we reasonably need to settle a claim.
53.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

Issued by Synthetic Policy Office 2

1.2. Limit means the most we will pay for all claims under a section arising from one incident.
1.3. Proof of purchase means an original receipt, invoice or bank statement showing the item, the price and the date.

2. Limits and excess
2.1. Baggage and Personal Belongings: limit $1,500 per incident; excess $50 per claim.
2.2. Emergency Medical Expenses: limit $25,000 per incident; excess $100 per claim.
2.3. Trip Cancellation: limit $5,000 per incident; excess $100 per claim.
2.4. Travel Delay: limit $300 per incident; excess $25 per claim.
2.5. The excess is deducted from the assessed loss before any limit or sublimit is applied.

3. Accessibility
3.1. This document is available in large print, braille or audio on request.

4. Payment of claims
4.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
4.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 15 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

5. Other insurance
5.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
5.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

6. Third-party administrators
6.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.
6.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

7. Market conditions
7.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

8. Trip Cancellation
8.1. We will pay non-refundable travel and accommodation costs if you must cancel the trip for a reason beyond your control.
8.2. No cover applies under this section to any incident that happens within the first 14 days after the policy start date.
8.3. The most we will pay for Excursions and tickets under this section is $300 per incident.
8.4. We will not pay for cancellation caused by a strike or other event that had been publicly announced before you bought the policy.
8.5. We will not pay for cancellation because you no longer wish to travel.

9. Exchange of information
9.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
9.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

10. Interest
10.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

11. General exclusions
11.1. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
11.2. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
11.3. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.

12. Missed departure
12.1. We will pay reasonable additional travel and accommodation costs to reach your destination if you arrive too late to board your booked transport because public transport fails.
12.2. You must allow enough time to reach the departure point, and must obtain written confirmation of the delay from the transport operator.

13. Interpretation
13.1. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the meaning of this policy.
13.2. Words in the singular include the plural and the other way round.
13.3. Words defined in the definitions section have the same meaning wherever they appear in bold or with an initial capital.

14. Sanctions
14.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

15. Records and evidence
15.1. You should keep receipts, photographs and valuations for items of significant value.
15.2. Where proof of value is missing, we may base any settlement on the price of a comparable item.
15.3. We may ask for evidence of how and when an item was acquired.

16. How to read this document
16.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
16.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
16.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

17. Customer support
17.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
17.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

18. Personal liability
18.1. We will pay damages you become legally liable to pay for accidental injury to another person or accidental damage to their property during the trip.
18.2. This section does not cover liability arising from the use of motor vehicles, boats or aircraft.
18.3. The most we will pay under this section is $2,000,000 for all claims arising from one event.

19. Claims documents
19.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.
19.2. We may ask for a medical certificate, a police report or a repair estimate, depending on the claim.

20. Making a claim
20.1. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.
20.2. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
20.3. You must notify us of a claim within 30 days of the incident. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.

21. Environmental commitment
21.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
21.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

22. Reasonable precautions
22.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
22.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

23. Repatriation
23.1. If our medical adviser agrees it is necessary, we will arrange and pay for you to be brought home.
23.2. We will decide the method of transport and the time of repatriation after speaking to the treating doctor.

24. Rental car excess
24.1. If you hire a car during the trip, we will reimburse any excess you must pay to the hire company after accidental damage to the car.
24.2. This section applies only to cars hired from a licensed rental company under a written agreement.

25. Salvage
25.1. When we replace an item, the damaged or recovered item becomes our property.
25.2. If stolen property is recovered after we have paid a claim, you must tell us and either return the payment or give us the property.

3.1. We will repair or replace your device if it stops working because of an electrical or mechanical fault.
3.2. No cover applies under this section to any incident that happens within the first 45 days after the policy start date.

15.1. If we pay a claim that is later found not to be covered, we may ask you to repay the amount.

16. Market conditions
16.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

17. Automatic renewal
17.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
17.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

18. Salvage
18.1. When we replace an item, the damaged or recovered item becomes our property.
18.2. If stolen property is recovered after we have paid a claim, you must tell us and either return the payment or give us the property.

19. Instalment agreements
19.1. If you pay by instalments, the instalment agreement is a separate contract with the finance provider.
19.2. Ending the instalment agreement does not cancel this policy, but unpaid premium remains due.

20. Accessibility
20.1. This document is available in large print, braille or audio on request.

21. Other insurance
21.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
21.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

22. Change of address
22.1. You must tell us within 30 days if you change your address.
22.2. We may change the premium or the terms from the date of the move.

23. Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
23.1. A person who is not a party to this policy has no right to enforce any of its terms.

24.1. If we accept a claim but disagree with you about the amount, the difference will be referred to an arbitrator appointed by both parties.

25. Claims documents
25.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.
25.2. We may ask for a medical certificate, a police report or a repair estimate, depending on the claim.

26. Payment of claims
26.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
26.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 5 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

27. Discounts
27.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
27.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

28. Sanctions
28.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

29. Communication
29.1. We will communicate with you in English.
29.2. We may record telephone calls for training and quality purposes.

30. Interest
30.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

31. Severability
31.1. If any term of this policy is found to be invalid, the remaining terms will continue in full force.

32. Data and backups
32.1. We are not responsible for recovering or restoring any data, software or settings stored on your device.
32.2. You should back up your data regularly and before sending the device for repair.

33. Exchange of information
33.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
33.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

34. Cancellation
34.1. You can cancel this policy within 14 days of receiving it and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made.

34.3. We can cancel this policy by giving you 30 days' written notice to the last address we hold.

35. Third-party administrators
35.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.
35.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

36. Transferring the plan
36.1. You may transfer the plan to a new owner of the device by telling us in writing.
36.2. The remaining term of the plan transfers with the device; the term does not restart.

37. Geographical limits
37.1. Cover applies only within the territory shown in the schedule.
37.2. Cover for property temporarily away from its usual place applies only within the same country.

38. Unrecoverable devices
38.1. If a device is found after we have replaced it, the found device becomes our property and must be sent to us.
38.2. We may block devices reported as lost or stolen so that they cannot be used on mobile networks.

39. Reasonable precautions
39.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
39.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

40. Notices
40.1. Any notice we give under this policy will be sent to the most recent postal or email address we hold.
40.2. Notices from you should be sent to the address shown in the schedule.

41. Currency
41.1. All amounts in this policy are in US dollars.
41.2. Claims for costs incurred in another currency will be converted at the exchange rate on the date the cost was incurred.

42. Fraud
42.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.
42.2. We may share information with fraud prevention agencies and other insurers.

43. Data protection
43.1. We will use the personal information you provide to administer this policy and to handle claims.
43.2. We will keep personal information only for as long as it is needed for these purposes or as required by law.
43.3. You can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold by writing to our data protection officer.

44. Records and evidence
44.1. You should keep receipts, photographs and valuations for items of significant value.
44.2. Where proof of value is missing, we may base any settlement on the price of a comparable item.
44.3. We may ask for evidence of how and when an item was acquired.

45. Duty of fair presentation
45.1. You must answer all questions we ask honestly and to the best of your knowledge.
45.2. If you give incorrect information deliberately or recklessly, we may treat this policy as if it never existed and keep the premium.
45.3. If you give incorrect information carelessly, we may reduce any claim payment in proportion to the premium that should have been charged.

46. Complaints
46.1. If you have a complaint, you should first contact our customer relations team, quoting the policy number.
46.2. We will acknowledge a complaint within five working days and aim to resolve it within eight weeks.
46.3. If you remain dissatisfied, you may be able to refer the complaint to an independent ombudsman service.

47. Governing law
47.1. This policy is governed by the law of the jurisdiction in which it was issued, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.
47.2. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of that jurisdiction.

48. Electronic documents
48.1. We will send documents by email unless you ask for paper copies.
48.2. You must tell us if your email address changes.
48.3. Documents sent by email are treated as received on the day they are sent.

49. Taxes
49.1. The premium includes any insurance premium tax at the current rate.
49.2. If the tax rate changes, we may adjust the premium from the date of the change.

50. Compensation scheme
50.1. We are covered by a financial services compensation scheme.
50.2. If we cannot meet our obligations, you may be entitled to compensation from the scheme, depending on the type of policy and the circumstances.

51. Subrogation
51.1. We will be entitled to take over and conduct in your name the defence or settlement of any claim.
51.2. We can take action in your name to recover any payment we make from anyone responsible for the loss.

52. Cooperation
52.1. You must give us all the help and information we reasonably need to settle a claim.
52.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

53. Joint policyholders
53.1. Where more than one person is named in the schedule, each of them is treated as having knowledge of anything any of them knows.
53.2. A notice sent to one named person is treated as sent to all of them.

54.1. Our helpline can give advice on setting up and using your device.
54.2. Software support does not include fixing problems caused by third-party apps or unofficial operating systems.

55. Changes in circumstances
55.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.

56. Renewal
56.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.

57. Customer support
57.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.

1. Definitions

3.1. We will repair or replace your device if it is accidentally damaged.
3.2. The most we will pay for Accessories under this section is $100 per incident.
3.3. The most we will pay for Wearables under this section is $250 per incident.

3.5. We will not pay for damage following a repair by anyone other than us or an authorised repairer. This exclusion does not apply if we approved the repair in writing beforehand.

4.1. We will repair or replace your device if it stops working because of an electrical or mechanical fault.
4.2. No cover applies under this section to any incident that happens within the first 30 days after the policy start date.

5.1. We will replace your device if it is stolen or lost.
5.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
5.3. The most we will pay for Accessories under this section is $50 per incident.
5.4. We will not pay for loss or theft of property left unattended in a vehicle or in a public place. This exclusion does not apply to property locked out of sight in the boot or trunk of a locked vehicle.
5.5. We will not pay for theft that was not reported to the police.

6. General exclusions
6.1. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.
6.2. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
6.3. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
6.4. We will not pay for loss of value or loss of use that does not involve physical loss or damage.

9.1. Our helpline can give advice on setting up and using your device.
9.2. Software support does not include fixing problems caused by third-party apps or unofficial operating systems.

10. Automatic renewal
10.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
10.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

11. Compensation scheme
11.1. We are covered by a financial services compensation scheme.
11.2. If we cannot meet our obligations, you may be entitled to compensation from the scheme, depending on the type of policy and the circumstances.

12. Change of address

13. Sanctions
13.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

14. Transferring the plan
14.1. You may transfer the plan to a new owner of the device by telling us in writing.
14.2. The remaining term of the plan transfers with the device; the term does not restart.

15. Premium payment
15.1. You must pay the premium on or before the policy start date or in the monthly instalments shown in the schedule.
15.2. If an instalment is not paid within 21 days of its due date, we may cancel the policy after giving notice.

16. Complaints
16.1. If you have a complaint, you should first contact our customer relations team, quoting the policy number.
16.2. We will acknowledge a complaint within five working days and aim to resolve it within eight weeks.
16.3. If you remain dissatisfied, you may be able to refer the complaint to an independent ombudsman service.

17. Joint policyholders
17.1. Where more than one person is named in the schedule, each of them is treated as having knowledge of anything any of them knows.
17.2. A notice sent to one named person is treated as sent to all of them.

18. Governing law
18.1. This policy is governed by the law of the jurisdiction in which it was issued, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.
18.2. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of that jurisdiction.

19. Assignment
19.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

20. Repair process
20.1. After a claim is accepted, we will send a prepaid mailer or book a courier collection.
20.2. We aim to return repaired devices within 15 business days of receiving them.

21. Data protection
21.1. We will use the personal information you provide to administer this policy and to handle claims.
21.2. We will keep personal information only for as long as it is needed for these purposes or as required by law.
21.3. You can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold by writing to our data protection officer.

22. Discounts
22.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
22.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

23. Claims documents
23.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.
23.2. We may ask for a medical certificate, a police report or a repair estimate, depending on the claim.

24. Exchange of information
24.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
24.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

25. Replacement devices
25.1. If we cannot repair your device economically, we will replace it with a replacement device.
25.2. Replacement devices may be a different colour and may be refurbished to an as-new standard.
25.3. Accessories are replaced only if they were lost or damaged in the same incident as the device.

26. Payment of claims
26.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
26.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 15 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

27. Geographical limits
27.1. Cover applies only within the territory shown in the schedule.
27.2. Cover for property temporarily away from its usual place applies only within the same country.

28. Salvage
28.1. When we replace an item, the damaged or recovered item becomes our property.
28.2. If stolen property is recovered after we have paid a claim, you must tell us and either return the payment or give us the property.

29. Waiver
29.1. If we do not enforce any term of this policy, that does not mean we have given up the right to enforce it later.

30. Cooperation
30.1. You must give us all the help and information we reasonably need to settle a claim.
30.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

31. Unrecoverable devices
31.1. If a device is found after we have replaced it, the found device becomes our property and must be sent to us.
31.2. We may block devices reported as lost or stolen so that they cannot be used on mobile networks.

32. Notices
32.1. Any notice we give under this policy will be sent to the most recent postal or email address we hold.
32.2. Notices from you should be sent to the address shown in the schedule.

33. Electronic documents
33.1. We will send documents by email unless you ask for paper copies.
33.2. You must tell us if your email address changes.
33.3. Documents sent by email are treated as received on the day they are sent.

34. Reasonable precautions
34.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
34.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

35. Communication
35.1. We will communicate with you in English.
35.2. We may record telephone calls for training and quality purposes.

36. Fraud
36.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.
36.2. We may share information with fraud prevention agencies and other insurers.

37. Interest
37.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

38. Interpretation
38.1. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the meaning of this policy.
38.2. Words in the singular include the plural and the other way round.
38.3. Words defined in the definitions section have the same meaning wherever they appear in bold or with an initial capital.

39. Other insurance
39.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
39.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

40. Renewal
40.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.
40.2. We are not obliged to offer renewal.

41. Currency
41.1. All amounts in this policy are in US dollars.
41.2. Claims for costs incurred in another currency will be converted at the exchange rate on the date the cost was incurred.

42. Third-party administrators
42.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.

43. Cancellation
43.1. You can cancel this policy within 14 days of receiving it and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made.
43.2. After the first 14 days you can cancel at any time; we will refund the premium for the unexpired period less an administration charge of $25.

44. Severability
44.1. If any term of this policy is found to be invalid, the remaining terms will continue in full force.

45. Subrogation
45.1. We will be entitled to take over and conduct in your name the defence or settlement of any claim.
45.2. We can take action in your name to recover any payment we make from anyone responsible for the loss.

46. Inflation
46.1. We may adjust limits at renewal in line with a published index of consumer prices.

47. Instalment agreements

ANNUAL MULTI-TRIP TRAVEL COVER
Issued by Synthetic Policy Office 2

1. Definitions
1.1. Business day means Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays.
1.2. Dental treatment means treatment of the teeth or gums.
1.3. Excursions and tickets means pre-booked excursions, tours, and event or theatre tickets.
1.4. Family means your spouse or partner and any children who live with you.
1.5. Hazardous activity means skydiving, motor racing, or trekking or climbing above 3,000 metres.
1.6. Incident means a single event, or a series of events arising from one cause.
1.7. Limit means the most we will pay for all claims under a section arising from one incident.
1.8. Physiotherapy means treatment of muscles and joints by a physiotherapist.
1.9. Policy period means twelve months from the policy start date shown in your schedule.
1.10. Pre-existing condition means any illness or injury for which you received treatment or advice in the 3 months before the policy start date.
1.11. Premium means the amount you must pay for this policy, including any taxes.
1.12. Proof of purchase means an original receipt, invoice or bank statement showing the item, the price and the date.
1.13. Public transport means any scheduled train, bus, coach, ferry or aircraft.
1.14. Qualifying delay means a delay to the scheduled departure of more than 8 hours.
1.15. Receipt means a document from the seller or provider showing the date, the amount paid and what was supplied.
1.16. Schedule means the document issued with this policy that shows your details, the covers you bought and any extensions.
1.17. Sports equipment means skis, snowboards, golf clubs, surfboards and bicycles.
1.18. Sublimit means a lower limit that applies to a particular class of property or treatment within a section.
1.19. Territory means the countries in which cover applies, as shown in the schedule.
1.20. Travelling companion means a person who has booked to travel with you on the same trip.
1.21. Trip means a journey that starts and ends in your home country during the policy period.
1.22. Valuables means laptops, tablets, mobile phones, cameras, watches and jewellery.

2. Limits and excess
2.1. Baggage and Personal Belongings: limit $3,000 per incident; excess $50 per claim.
2.2. Emergency Medical Expenses: limit $10,000 per incident; excess $250 per claim.
2.3. Trip Cancellation: limit $5,000 per incident; excess $100 per claim.
2.4. Travel Delay: limit $300 per incident; excess $25 per claim.
2.5. The excess is deducted from the assessed loss before any limit or sublimit is applied.

3. Trip Cancellation
3.1. We will pay non-refundable travel and accommodation costs if you must cancel the trip for a reason beyond your control.
3.2. No cover applies under this section to any incident that happens within the first 10 days after the policy start date.
3.3. The most we will pay for Excursions and tickets under this section is $300 per incident.
3.4. We will not pay for cancellation caused by a strike or other event that had been publicly announced before you bought the policy.
3.5. We will not pay for cancellation because you no longer wish to travel.

4. Baggage and Personal Belongings
4.1. We will pay for the loss of, theft of, or damage to your baggage and personal belongings during the trip.
4.2. The most we will pay for Valuables under this section is $500 per incident.
4.3. The most we will pay for Sports equipment under this section is $450 per incident.
4.4. We will not pay for loss or theft of property left unattended in a vehicle or in a public place. This exclusion does not apply to property locked out of sight in the boot or trunk of a locked vehicle.
4.5. We will not pay for loss caused by confiscation or detention by customs or other officials.
4.6. We will not pay for damage caused by wear and tear or gradual deterioration.

5. Emergency Medical Expenses
5.1. We will pay reasonable and necessary emergency medical costs incurred during the trip.
5.2. The most we will pay for Dental treatment under this section is $250 per incident.
5.3. The most we will pay for Physiotherapy under this section is $300 per incident.
5.4. We will not pay for treatment of a pre-existing condition.
5.5. We will not pay for injury or illness arising from a hazardous activity. This exclusion does not apply if the Adventure Sports extension is shown in your schedule.
5.6. We will not pay for any claim arising from your being under the influence of alcohol or drugs.

6. Optional cover: Travel Delay
6.1. We will pay reasonable costs of meals and accommodation if your outbound departure is delayed.
6.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
6.3. We will not pay for any delay that is not a qualifying delay.

7. General exclusions
7.1. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
7.2. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
7.3. We will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits us from paying.

8. Making a claim
8.1. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
8.2. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.
8.3. You must notify us of a claim within 30 days of the incident. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.

9. Claims documents
9.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.
9.2. We may ask for a medical certificate, a police report or a repair estimate, depending on the claim.

10. Change of address
10.1. You must tell us within 30 days if you change your address.
10.2. We may change the premium or the terms from the date of the move.

11. Rental car excess
11.1. If you hire a car during the trip, we will reimburse any excess you must pay to the hire company after accidental damage to the car.
11.2. This section applies only to cars hired from a licensed rental company under a written agreement.

12. How to read this document
12.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
12.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
12.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

13. Electronic documents
13.1. We will send documents by email unless you ask for paper copies.
13.2. You must tell us if your email address changes.
13.3. Documents sent by email are treated as received on the day they are sent.

14. Compensation scheme
14.1. We are covered by a financial services compensation scheme.
14.2. If we cannot meet our obligations, you may be entitled to compensation from the scheme, depending on the type of policy and the circumstances.

15. Premium payment
15.1. You must pay the premium on or before the policy start date or in the monthly instalments shown in the schedule.
15.2. If an instalment is not paid within 21 days of its due date, we may cancel the policy after giving notice.

16. Reasonable precautions
16.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
16.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

17. Changes in circumstances
17.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.
17.2. We may then change the premium or the terms of this policy, or cancel it.

18. Missed departure
18.1. We will pay reasonable additional travel and accommodation costs to reach your destination if you arrive too late to board your booked transport because public transport fails.
18.2. You must allow enough time to reach the departure point, and must obtain written confirmation of the delay from the transport operator.

19. Discounts
19.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
19.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

20. Notices
20.1. Any notice we give under this policy will be sent to the most recent postal or email address we hold.
20.2. Notices from you should be sent to the address shown in the schedule.

21. Duty of fair presentation
21.1. You must answer all questions we ask honestly and to the best of your knowledge.
21.2. If you give incorrect information deliberately or recklessly, we may treat this policy as if it never existed and keep the premium.
21.3. If you give incorrect information carelessly, we may reduce any claim payment in proportion to the premium that should have been charged.

22. Fraud
22.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.
22.2. We may share information with fraud prevention agencies and other insurers.

23. Automatic renewal
23.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
23.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

24. Environmental commitment
24.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
24.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

25. Records and evidence
25.1. You should keep receipts, photographs and valuations for items of significant value.
25.2. Where proof of value is missing, we may base any settlement on the price of a comparable item.
25.3. We may ask for evidence of how and when an item was acquired.

26. Geographical limits
26.1. Cover applies only within the territory shown in the schedule.
26.2. Cover for property temporarily away from its usual place applies only within the same country.

27. Accessibility
27.1. This document is available in large print, braille or audio on request.

28. Recovery of costs
28.1. If we pay a claim that is later found not to be covered, we may ask you to repay the amount.

29. Currency
29.1. All amounts in this policy are in US dollars.
29.2. Claims for costs incurred in another currency will be converted at the exchange rate on the date the cost was incurred.

30. Cancellation
30.1. You can cancel this policy within 14 days of receiving it and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made.
30.2. After the first 14 days you can cancel at any time; we will refund the premium for the unexpired period less an administration charge of $15.
30.3. We can cancel this policy by giving you 30 days' written notice to the last address we hold.

31. Severability
31.1. If any term of this policy is found to be invalid, the remaining terms will continue in full force.

32. Joint policyholders
32.1. Where more than one person is named in the schedule, each of them is treated as having knowledge of anything any of them knows.
32.2. A notice sent to one named person is treated as sent to all of them.

33. Cooperation
33.1. You must give us all the help and information we reasonably need to settle a claim.
33.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

34. Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
34.1. A person who is not a party to this policy has no right to enforce any of its terms.

35. Personal liability
35.1. We will pay damages you become legally liable to pay for accidental injury to another person or accidental damage to their property during the trip.
35.2. This section does not cover liability arising from the use of motor vehicles, boats or aircraft.
35.3. The most we will pay under this section is $2,000,000 for all claims arising from one event.

36. Arbitration
36.1. If we accept a claim but disagree with you about the amount, the difference will be referred to an arbitrator appointed by both parties.
36.2. Where arbitration applies, obtaining an award is a condition precedent to any legal action against us.

37. Interest
37.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

38. Subrogation
38.1. We will be entitled to take over and conduct in your name the defence or settlement of any claim.
38.2. We can take action in your name to recover any payment we make from anyone responsible for the loss.

39. Emergency assistance
39.1. Our emergency assistance service is available 24 hours a day on the number shown in the schedule.
39.2. You must contact the assistance service before being admitted to hospital as an in-patient, unless it is an emergency.
39.3. The assistance service can arrange payment guarantees, interpreters and transport home.

40. Market conditions
40.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

41. Sanctions
41.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

42. Payment of claims
42.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
42.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 5 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

43. Data protection
43.1. We will use the personal information you provide to administer this policy and to handle claims.
43.2. We will keep personal information only for as long as it is needed for these purposes or as required by law.
43.3. You can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold by writing to our data protection officer.

44. Customer support
44.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
44.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

45. Repatriation
45.1. If our medical adviser agrees it is necessary, we will arrange and pay for you to be brought home.
45.2. We will decide the method of transport and the time of repatriation after speaking to the treating doctor.

46. Assignment
46.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

47. Communication
47.1. We will communicate with you in English.
47.2. We may record telephone calls for training and quality purposes.

48. Complaints
48.1. If you have a complaint, you should first contact our customer relations team, quoting the policy number.
48.2. We will acknowledge a complaint within five working days and aim to resolve it within eight weeks.
48.3. If you remain dissatisfied, you may be able to refer the complaint to an independent ombudsman service.

49. Salvage
49.1. When we replace an item, the damaged or recovered item becomes our property.
49.2. If stolen property is recovered after we have paid a claim, you must tell us and either return the payment or give us the property.

50. Renewal
50.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.
50.2. We are not obliged to offer renewal.

51. Taxes
51.1. The premium includes any insurance premium tax at the current rate.
51.2. If the tax rate changes, we may adjust the premium from the date of the change.

52. Interpretation
52.1. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the meaning of this policy.
52.2. Words in the singular include the plural and the other way round.
52.3. Words defined in the definitions section have the same meaning wherever they appear in bold or with an initial capital.

53. Third-party administrators
53.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.
53.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

54. Legal expenses abroad
54.1. We will pay legal costs to pursue compensation for your injury or death caused by a third party during the trip.
54.2. We will not pay legal costs unless our legal adviser agrees that the claim has a reasonable prospect of success.

55. Inflation
55.1. We may adjust limits at renewal in line with a published index of consumer prices.
55.2. Any adjustment will be shown in your renewal documents; limits do not change during a policy period.

56. Other insurance
56.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
56.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

57. Governing law
57.1. This policy is governed by the law of the jurisdiction in which it was issued, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.
57.2. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of that jurisdiction.

58. Waiver
58.1. If we do not enforce any term of this policy, that does not mean we have given up the right to enforce it later.

59. Exchange of information
59.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
59.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

60. Instalment agreements
60.1. If you pay by instalments, the instalment agreement is a separate contract with the finance provider.
60.2. Ending the instalment agreement does not cancel this policy, but unpaid premium remains due.

1. Definitions
1.1. Assessed loss means the cost of repair or replacement agreed by us, before any excess, limit or sublimit is applied.
