1.3. Dental treatment means treatment of the teeth or gums.
1.4. Excursions and tickets means pre-booked excursions, tours, and event or theatre tickets.
1.5. Family means your spouse or partner and any children who live with you.
1.6. Hazardous activity means skydiving, motor racing, or trekking or climbing above 3,000 metres.
1.7. Incident means a single event, or a series of events arising from one cause.
1.8. Limit means the most we will pay for all claims under a section arising from one incident.
1.9. Physiotherapy means treatment of muscles and joints by a physiotherapist.
1.10. Policy period means twelve months from the policy start date shown in your schedule.
1.11. Pre-existing condition means any illness or injury for which you received treatment or advice in the 3 months before the policy start date.
1.12. Premium means the amount you must pay for this policy, including any taxes.
1.13. Proof of purchase means an original receipt, invoice or bank statement showing the item, the price and the date.
1.14. Public transport means any scheduled train, bus, coach, ferry or aircraft.
1.15. Qualifying delay means a delay to the scheduled departure of more than 8 hours.
1.16. Receipt means a document from the seller or provider showing the date, the amount paid and what was supplied.
1.17. Sports equipment means skis, snowboards, golf clubs, surfboards and bicycles.
1.18. Sublimit means a lower limit that applies to a particular class of property or treatment within a section.
1.19. Territory means the countries in which cover applies, as shown in the schedule.
1.20. Travelling companion means a person who has booked to travel with you on the same trip.
1.21. Trip means a journey that starts and ends in your home country during the policy period.
1.22. Valuables means laptops, tablets, mobile phones, cameras, watches and jewellery.

2. Limits and excess
2.1. Baggage and Personal Belongings: limit $3,000 per incident; excess $100 per claim.
2.2. Emergency Medical Expenses: limit $50,000 per incident; excess $150 per claim.
2.3. Trip Cancellation: limit $2,000 per incident; excess $100 per claim.
2.4. Travel Delay: limit $500 per incident; excess $50 per claim.
2.5. Any limit or sublimit is applied to the assessed loss first, and the excess is then deducted from the result.

3. Baggage and Personal Belongings
3.1. We will pay for the loss of, theft of, or damage to your baggage and personal belongings during the trip.
3.2. The most we will pay for Valuables under this section is $500 per incident.
3.3. The most we will pay for Sports equipment under this section is $450 per incident.
3.4. We will not pay for loss or theft of property left unattended in a vehicle or in a public place. This exclusion does not apply to property locked out of sight in the boot or trunk of a locked vehicle.
3.5. We will not pay for loss caused by confiscation or detention by customs or other officials.
3.6. We will not pay for damage caused by wear and tear or gradual deterioration.

4. Trip Cancellation
4.1. We will pay non-refundable travel and accommodation costs if you must cancel the trip for a reason beyond your control.
4.2. No cover applies under this section to any incident that happens within the first 7 days after the policy start date.
4.3. The most we will pay for Excursions and tickets under this section is $300 per incident.
4.4. We will not pay for cancellation caused by a strike or other event that had been publicly announced before you bought the policy.
4.5. We will not pay for cancellation because you no longer wish to travel.

5. Optional cover: Travel Delay
5.1. We will pay reasonable costs of meals and accommodation if your outbound departure is delayed.
5.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
5.3. We will not pay for any delay that is not a qualifying delay.

6. Emergency Medical Expenses
6.1. We will pay reasonable and necessary emergency medical costs incurred during the trip.
6.2. The most we will pay for Dental treatment under this section is $250 per incident.
6.3. The most we will pay for Physiotherapy under this section is $500 per incident.
6.4. We will not pay for treatment of a pre-existing condition.
6.5. We will not pay for injury or illness arising from a hazardous activity. This exclusion does not apply if the Adventure Sports extension is shown in your schedule.
6.6. We will not pay for any claim arising from your being under the influence of alcohol or drugs.

7. General exclusions
7.1. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
7.2. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.
7.3. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
7.4. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
7.5. We will not pay for loss of value or loss of use that does not involve physical loss or damage.
7.6. We will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits us from paying.

8. Making a claim
8.1. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
8.2. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.
8.3. You must notify us of a claim within 30 days of the incident. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.

9. Cancellation
9.1. You can cancel this policy within 14 days of receiving it and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made.
9.2. After the first 14 days you can cancel at any time; we will refund the premium for the unexpired period less an administration charge of $25.
9.3. We can cancel this policy by giving you 30 days' written notice to the last address we hold.

10. Joint policyholders
10.1. Where more than one person is named in the schedule, each of them is treated as having knowledge of anything any of them knows.
10.2. A notice sent to one named person is treated as sent to all of them.

11. Duty of fair presentation
11.1. You must answer all questions we ask honestly and to the best of your knowledge.
11.2. If you give incorrect information deliberately or recklessly, we may treat this policy as if it never existed and keep the premium.
11.3. If you give incorrect information carelessly, we may reduce any claim payment in proportion to the premium that should have been charged.

12. Changes in circumstances
12.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.
12.2. We may then change the premium or the terms of this policy, or cancel it.

13. Third-party administrators
13.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.
13.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

14. Taxes
14.1. The premium includes any insurance premium tax at the current rate.
14.2. If the tax rate changes, we may adjust the premium from the date of the change.

15. Complaints
15.1. If you have a complaint, you should first contact our customer relations team, quoting the policy number.
15.2. We will acknowledge a complaint within five working days and aim to resolve it within eight weeks.
15.3. If you remain dissatisfied, you may be able to refer the complaint to an independent ombudsman service.

16. Cooperation
16.1. You must give us all the help and information we reasonably need to settle a claim.
16.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

17. Environmental commitment
17.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
17.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

18. How to read this document
18.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
18.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
18.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

19. Personal liability
19.1. We will pay damages you become legally liable to pay for accidental injury to another person or accidental damage to their property during the trip.
19.2. This section does not cover liability arising from the use of motor vehicles, boats or aircraft.
19.3. The most we will pay under this section is $1,000,000 for all claims arising from one event.

20. Interest
20.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

21. Notices
21.1. Any notice we give under this policy will be sent to the most recent postal or email address we hold.
21.2. Notices from you should be sent to the address shown in the schedule.

22. Repatriation
22.1. If our medical adviser agrees it is necessary, we will arrange and pay for you to be brought home.
22.2. We will decide the method of transport and the time of repatriation after speaking to the treating doctor.

23. Subrogation
23.1. We will be entitled to take over and conduct in your name the defence or settlement of any claim.
23.2. We can take action in your name to recover any payment we make from anyone responsible for the loss.

24. Severability
24.1. If any term of this policy is found to be invalid, the remaining terms will continue in full force.

25. Currency
25.1. All amounts in this policy are in US dollars.
25.2. Claims for costs incurred in another currency will be converted at the exchange rate on the date the cost was incurred.

26. Waiver
26.1. If we do not enforce any term of this policy, that does not mean we have given up the right to enforce it later.

27. Arbitration
27.1. If we accept a claim but disagree with you about the amount, the difference will be referred to an arbitrator appointed by both parties.
27.2. Where arbitration applies, obtaining an award is a condition precedent to any legal action against us.

28. Market conditions
28.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

29. Discounts
29.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
29.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

30. Electronic documents
30.1. We will send documents by email unless you ask for paper copies.
30.2. You must tell us if your email address changes.
30.3. Documents sent by email are treated as received on the day they are sent.

31. Renewal
31.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.
31.2. We are not obliged to offer renewal.

32. Exchange of information
32.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
32.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

33. Other insurance
33.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
33.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

34. Data protection
34.1. We will use the personal information you provide to administer this policy and to handle claims.
34.2. We will keep personal information only for as long as it is needed for these purposes or as required by law.
34.3. You can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold by writing to our data protection officer.

35. Geographical limits
35.1. Cover applies only within the territory shown in the schedule.
35.2. Cover for property temporarily away from its usual place applies only within the same country.

Issued by Synthetic Policy Office 3

1. Definitions
1.1. Accessories means cases, chargers, earbuds and styluses.

1.6. Breakdown means the failure of a part to work as the manufacturer intended, from an internal electrical or mechanical fault.
1.7. Business day means Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays.
1.8. Device means the item shown in the schedule, bought new from an authorised retailer.
1.9. Incident means a single event, or a series of events arising from one cause.
1.10. Manufacturer's warranty period means the first 24 months after the device was bought.
1.11. Policy period means twelve months from the policy start date shown in your schedule.
1.12. Receipt means a document from the seller or provider showing the date, the amount paid and what was supplied.
1.13. Replacement device means a device of the same or similar specification, which may be refurbished.
1.14. Schedule means the document issued with this policy that shows your details, the covers you bought and any extensions.
1.15. Wearables means smartwatches and fitness trackers.

2. Limits and service fee
2.1. Accidental Damage: limit $1,200 per incident; service fee $99 per claim.
2.2. Breakdown: limit $600 per incident; service fee $49 per claim.
2.3. Theft and Loss: limit $1,200 per incident; service fee $99 per claim.
2.4. Any limit or sublimit is applied to the assessed loss first, and the service fee is then deducted from the result.

3. Breakdown
3.1. We will repair or replace your device if it stops working because of an electrical or mechanical fault.
3.2. No cover applies under this section to any incident that happens within the first 45 days after the policy start date.
3.3. The most we will pay for Battery replacement under this section is $120 per incident.
3.4. We will not pay for breakdowns during the manufacturer's warranty period.
3.5. We will not pay for breakdown caused by liquid getting into the device.

4. Optional cover: Theft and Loss
4.1. We will replace your device if it is stolen or lost.
4.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
4.3. The most we will pay for Accessories under this section is $50 per incident.
4.4. We will not pay for loss or theft of property left unattended in a vehicle or in a public place. This exclusion does not apply to property locked out of sight in the boot or trunk of a locked vehicle.
4.5. We will not pay for theft that was not reported to the police.

5. Accidental Damage
5.1. We will repair or replace your device if it is accidentally damaged.
5.2. The most we will pay for Accessories under this section is $100 per incident.
5.3. The most we will pay for Wearables under this section is $250 per incident.
5.4. We will not pay for cosmetic damage, such as scratches or dents, that does not affect how the device works.
5.5. We will not pay for damage following a repair by anyone other than us or an authorised repairer. This exclusion does not apply if we approved the repair in writing beforehand.

6. General exclusions
6.1. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
6.2. We will not pay for loss of value or loss of use that does not involve physical loss or damage.
6.3. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.
6.4. We will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits us from paying.

7. Making a claim
7.1. You must notify us of a claim within 60 days of the incident. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.
7.2. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.
7.3. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.

8. Automatic renewal
8.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
8.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

9. Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
9.1. A person who is not a party to this policy has no right to enforce any of its terms.

10. Inflation
10.1. We may adjust limits at renewal in line with a published index of consumer prices.
10.2. Any adjustment will be shown in your renewal documents; limits do not change during a policy period.

11. Communication
11.1. We will communicate with you in English.
11.2. We may record telephone calls for training and quality purposes.

12. Changes in circumstances
12.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.
12.2. We may then change the premium or the terms of this policy, or cancel it.

13. Joint policyholders
13.1. Where more than one person is named in the schedule, each of them is treated as having knowledge of anything any of them knows.
13.2. A notice sent to one named person is treated as sent to all of them.

14. Complaints
14.1. If you have a complaint, you should first contact our customer relations team, quoting the policy number.
14.2. We will acknowledge a complaint within five working days and aim to resolve it within eight weeks.
14.3. If you remain dissatisfied, you may be able to refer the complaint to an independent ombudsman service.

15. Sanctions
15.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

16. Recovery of costs
16.1. If we pay a claim that is later found not to be covered, we may ask you to repay the amount.

17. Instalment agreements
17.1. If you pay by instalments, the instalment agreement is a separate contract with the finance provider.
17.2. Ending the instalment agreement does not cancel this policy, but unpaid premium remains due.

18. Fraud
18.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.
18.2. We may share information with fraud prevention agencies and other insurers.

19. Change of address
19.1. You must tell us within 30 days if you change your address.
19.2. We may change the premium or the terms from the date of the move.

20. Interpretation
20.1. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the meaning of this policy.
20.2. Words in the singular include the plural and the other way round.
20.3. Words defined in the definitions section have the same meaning wherever they appear in bold or with an initial capital.

21. How to read this document
21.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
21.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
21.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

22. Market conditions
22.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

23. Cancellation
23.1. You can cancel this policy within 14 days of receiving it and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made.
23.2. After the first 14 days you can cancel at any time; we will refund the premium for the unexpired period less an administration charge of $25.
23.3. We can cancel this policy by giving you 30 days' written notice to the last address we hold.

24. Records and evidence
24.1. You should keep receipts, photographs and valuations for items of significant value.
24.2. Where proof of value is missing, we may base any settlement on the price of a comparable item.
24.3. We may ask for evidence of how and when an item was acquired.

25. Environmental commitment
25.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
25.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

26. Electronic documents
26.1. We will send documents by email unless you ask for paper copies.
26.2. You must tell us if your email address changes.
26.3. Documents sent by email are treated as received on the day they are sent.

27. Renewal
27.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.
27.2. We are not obliged to offer renewal.

28. Duty of fair presentation
28.1. You must answer all questions we ask honestly and to the best of your knowledge.
28.2. If you give incorrect information deliberately or recklessly, we may treat this policy as if it never existed and keep the premium.
28.3. If you give incorrect information carelessly, we may reduce any claim payment in proportion to the premium that should have been charged.

29. Discounts
29.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
29.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

30. Subrogation
30.1. We will be entitled to take over and conduct in your name the defence or settlement of any claim.
30.2. We can take action in your name to recover any payment we make from anyone responsible for the loss.

31. Assignment
31.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

7.2. If the tax rate changes, we may adjust the premium from the date of the change.

8. Governing law
8.1. This policy is governed by the law of the jurisdiction in which it was issued, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.
8.2. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of that jurisdiction.

9. Records and evidence
9.1. You should keep receipts, photographs and valuations for items of significant value.
9.2. Where proof of value is missing, we may base any settlement on the price of a comparable item.
9.3. We may ask for evidence of how and when an item was acquired.

10. Market conditions
10.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

11. Cooperation
11.1. You must give us all the help and information we reasonably need to settle a claim.
11.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

12. Sanctions
12.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

13. Complaints
13.1. If you have a complaint, you should first contact our customer relations team, quoting the policy number.
13.2. We will acknowledge a complaint within five working days and aim to resolve it within eight weeks.
13.3. If you remain dissatisfied, you may be able to refer the complaint to an independent ombudsman service.

14. Replacement devices
14.1. If we cannot repair your device economically, we will replace it with a replacement device.
14.2. Replacement devices may be a different colour and may be refurbished to an as-new standard.
14.3. Accessories are replaced only if they were lost or damaged in the same incident as the device.

15. Change of address
15.1. You must tell us within 30 days if you change your address.
15.2. We may change the premium or the terms from the date of the move.

16. Salvage
16.1. When we replace an item, the damaged or recovered item becomes our property.
16.2. If stolen property is recovered after we have paid a claim, you must tell us and either return the payment or give us the property.

17. Accidental Damage
17.1. We will repair or replace your device if it is accidentally damaged.
17.2. The most we will pay for Accessories under this section is $50 per incident.
17.3. The most we will pay for Wearables under this section is $300 per incident.
17.4. We will not pay for cosmetic damage, such as scratches or dents, that does not affect how the device works.
17.5. We will not pay for damage following a repair by anyone other than us or an authorised repairer. This exclusion does not apply if we approved the repair in writing beforehand.

18. Recovery of costs
18.1. If we pay a claim that is later found not to be covered, we may ask you to repay the amount.

19. Optional cover: Theft and Loss
19.1. We will replace your device if it is stolen or lost.
19.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
19.3. The most we will pay for Accessories under this section is $100 per incident.
19.4. We will not pay for loss or theft of property left unattended in a vehicle or in a public place. This exclusion does not apply to property locked out of sight in the boot or trunk of a locked vehicle.
19.5. We will not pay for theft that was not reported to the police.

20. Breakdown
20.1. We will repair or replace your device if it stops working because of an electrical or mechanical fault.
20.2. No cover applies under this section to any incident that happens within the first 30 days after the policy start date.
20.3. The most we will pay for Battery replacement under this section is $120 per incident.
20.4. We will not pay for breakdowns during the manufacturer's warranty period.
20.5. We will not pay for breakdown caused by liquid getting into the device.

21. How to read this document
21.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
21.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
21.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

22. Fraud
22.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.
22.2. We may share information with fraud prevention agencies and other insurers.

23. Discounts
23.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
23.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

24. Duty of fair presentation
24.1. You must answer all questions we ask honestly and to the best of your knowledge.
24.2. If you give incorrect information deliberately or recklessly, we may treat this policy as if it never existed and keep the premium.
24.3. If you give incorrect information carelessly, we may reduce any claim payment in proportion to the premium that should have been charged.

25. Changes in circumstances
25.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.
25.2. We may then change the premium or the terms of this policy, or cancel it.

26. Geographical limits
26.1. Cover applies only within the territory shown in the schedule.
26.2. Cover for property temporarily away from its usual place applies only within the same country.

27. Other insurance
27.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
27.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

28. Environmental commitment
28.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
28.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

29. Communication
29.1. We will communicate with you in English.
29.2. We may record telephone calls for training and quality purposes.

30. Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
30.1. A person who is not a party to this policy has no right to enforce any of its terms.

31. Claims documents
31.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.
31.2. We may ask for a medical certificate, a police report or a repair estimate, depending on the claim.

32. Severability
32.1. If any term of this policy is found to be invalid, the remaining terms will continue in full force.

33. Interpretation
33.1. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the meaning of this policy.
33.2. Words in the singular include the plural and the other way round.
33.3. Words defined in the definitions section have the same meaning wherever they appear in bold or with an initial capital.

34. General exclusions
34.1. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
34.2. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
34.3. We will not pay for loss of value or loss of use that does not involve physical loss or damage.
34.4. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.

35. Making a claim
35.1. You must notify us of a claim within 14 days of the incident. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.
35.2. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
35.3. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.

36. Interest
36.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

37. Compensation scheme
37.1. We are covered by a financial services compensation scheme.
37.2. If we cannot meet our obligations, you may be entitled to compensation from the scheme, depending on the type of policy and the circumstances.

38. Software support
38.1. Our helpline can give advice on setting up and using your device.
38.2. Software support does not include fixing problems caused by third-party apps or unofficial operating systems.

39. Assignment
39.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

40. Customer support
40.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
40.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

41. Exchange of information
41.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
41.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

42. Notices
42.1. Any notice we give under this policy will be sent to the most recent postal or email address we hold.
42.2. Notices from you should be sent to the address shown in the schedule.

43. Waiver
43.1. If we do not enforce any term of this policy, that does not mean we have given up the right to enforce it later.

21. Governing law

23. Complaints
23.1. If you have a complaint, you should first contact our customer relations team, quoting the policy number.
23.2. We will acknowledge a complaint within five working days and aim to resolve it within eight weeks.
23.3. If you remain dissatisfied, you may be able to refer the complaint to an independent ombudsman service.

24. Communication

24.2. We may record telephone calls for training and quality purposes.

26. Automatic renewal
26.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
26.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

27. How to read this document
27.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.

27.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

28. Geographical limits
28.1. Cover applies only within the territory shown in the schedule.
28.2. Cover for property temporarily away from its usual place applies only within the same country.

29. Duty of fair presentation
29.1. You must answer all questions we ask honestly and to the best of your knowledge.
29.2. If you give incorrect information deliberately or recklessly, we may treat this policy as if it never existed and keep the premium.
29.3. If you give incorrect information carelessly, we may reduce any claim payment in proportion to the premium that should have been charged.

30. Environmental commitment
30.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
30.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

31. Discounts
31.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
31.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

32. Subrogation
32.1. We will be entitled to take over and conduct in your name the defence or settlement of any claim.
32.2. We can take action in your name to recover any payment we make from anyone responsible for the loss.

33. Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
33.1. A person who is not a party to this policy has no right to enforce any of its terms.

34. Changes in circumstances
34.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.
34.2. We may then change the premium or the terms of this policy, or cancel it.

35. Cancellation
35.1. You can cancel this policy within 14 days of receiving it and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made.
35.2. After the first 14 days you can cancel at any time; we will refund the premium for the unexpired period less an administration charge of $30.
35.3. We can cancel this policy by giving you 30 days' written notice to the last address we hold.

36. Customer support
36.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
36.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

37. Appeals
37.1. If we decline all or part of a claim, you may appeal in writing within 60 days of the decision.
37.2. An appeal will be reviewed by someone who was not involved in the original decision.
37.3. We will give you a written decision on the appeal within 30 days.

38. Compensation scheme
38.1. We are covered by a financial services compensation scheme.
38.2. If we cannot meet our obligations, you may be entitled to compensation from the scheme, depending on the type of policy and the circumstances.

39. Eligibility
39.1. Employees who work at least 20 hours a week are eligible to join the plan from their first day of employment.
39.2. Contractors, agency workers and employees on unpaid leave of more than three months are not eligible.

40. Third-party administrators
40.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.
40.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

41. Premium payment
41.1. You must pay the premium on or before the policy start date or in the monthly instalments shown in the schedule.
41.2. If an instalment is not paid within 21 days of its due date, we may cancel the policy after giving notice.

42. Reasonable precautions
42.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
42.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

43. Exchange of information
43.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
43.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

44. Fraud
44.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.
44.2. We may share information with fraud prevention agencies and other insurers.

45. Arbitration
45.1. If we accept a claim but disagree with you about the amount, the difference will be referred to an arbitrator appointed by both parties.
45.2. Where arbitration applies, obtaining an award is a condition precedent to any legal action against us.

46. Accessibility
46.1. This document is available in large print, braille or audio on request.

47. Currency
47.1. All amounts in this policy are in US dollars.
47.2. Claims for costs incurred in another currency will be converted at the exchange rate on the date the cost was incurred.

48. Data protection
48.1. We will use the personal information you provide to administer this policy and to handle claims.
48.2. We will keep personal information only for as long as it is needed for these purposes or as required by law.
48.3. You can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold by writing to our data protection officer.

49. Recovery of costs
49.1. If we pay a claim that is later found not to be covered, we may ask you to repay the amount.

50. Notices
50.1. Any notice we give under this policy will be sent to the most recent postal or email address we hold.
50.2. Notices from you should be sent to the address shown in the schedule.

51. Market conditions
51.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

52. Assignment
52.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

53. Instalment agreements
53.1. If you pay by instalments, the instalment agreement is a separate contract with the finance provider.
53.2. Ending the instalment agreement does not cancel this policy, but unpaid premium remains due.

54. Records and evidence
54.1. You should keep receipts, photographs and valuations for items of significant value.
54.2. Where proof of value is missing, we may base any settlement on the price of a comparable item.
54.3. We may ask for evidence of how and when an item was acquired.

55. Payment of claims
55.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
55.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 15 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

56. Joint policyholders
56.1. Where more than one person is named in the schedule, each of them is treated as having knowledge of anything any of them knows.
56.2. A notice sent to one named person is treated as sent to all of them.

57. Dependants
57.1. You may enrol dependants at the start of each plan year or within 30 days of a qualifying life event.
57.2. Benefits paid for dependants count towards the same annual limits as your own claims.

58. Other insurance
58.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
58.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

59. Waiver
59.1. If we do not enforce any term of this policy, that does not mean we have given up the right to enforce it later.

60. Claims documents
60.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.

54. Payment of claims

55.1. If we accept a claim but disagree with you about the amount, the difference will be referred to an arbitrator appointed by both parties.

1. Definitions
1.1. Accessories means cases, chargers, earbuds and styluses.
1.2. Accessories means cases, chargers and earbuds.
1.3. Assessed loss means the cost of repair or replacement agreed by us, before any service fee, limit or sublimit is applied.
1.4. Authorised repairer means a repairer approved in writing by us.
1.5. Battery replacement means replacement batteries and battery repairs.
1.6. Business day means Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays.
1.7. Device means the item shown in the schedule, bought new from an authorised retailer.
1.8. Family means your spouse or partner and any children who live with you.
1.9. Incident means a single event, or a series of events arising from one cause.
1.10. Limit means the most we will pay for all claims under a section arising from one incident.
1.11. Manufacturer's warranty period means the first 12 months after the device was bought.
1.12. Policy period means twelve months from the policy start date shown in your schedule.
1.13. Premium means the amount you must pay for this policy, including any taxes.
1.14. Proof of purchase means an original receipt, invoice or bank statement showing the item, the price and the date.
1.15. Receipt means a document from the seller or provider showing the date, the amount paid and what was supplied.
1.16. Schedule means the document issued with this policy that shows your details, the covers you bought and any extensions.
1.17. Sublimit means a lower limit that applies to a particular class of property or treatment within a section.
1.18. Wearables means smartwatches and fitness trackers.

2. Limits and service fee
2.1. Accidental Damage: limit $800 per incident; service fee $79 per claim.
2.2. Breakdown: limit $1,500 per incident; service fee $25 per claim.
2.3. Theft and Loss: limit $800 per incident; service fee $99 per claim.
2.4. Any limit or sublimit is applied to the assessed loss first, and the service fee is then deducted from the result.

3. Breakdown
3.1. We will repair or replace your device if it stops working because of an electrical or mechanical fault.
3.2. No cover applies under this section to any incident that happens within the first 45 days after the policy start date.
3.3. The most we will pay for Battery replacement under this section is $80 per incident.
3.4. We will not pay for breakdowns during the manufacturer's warranty period.
3.5. We will not pay for breakdown caused by liquid getting into the device.

4. Optional cover: Theft and Loss
4.1. We will replace your device if it is stolen or lost.
4.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
4.3. The most we will pay for Accessories under this section is $100 per incident.
4.4. We will not pay for loss or theft of property left unattended in a vehicle or in a public place. This exclusion does not apply to property locked out of sight in the boot or trunk of a locked vehicle.
4.5. We will not pay for theft that was not reported to the police.

5. Accidental Damage
5.1. We will repair or replace your device if it is accidentally damaged.
5.2. The most we will pay for Accessories under this section is $100 per incident.
5.3. The most we will pay for Wearables under this section is $250 per incident.
5.4. We will not pay for cosmetic damage, such as scratches or dents, that does not affect how the device works.
5.5. We will not pay for damage following a repair by anyone other than us or an authorised repairer. This exclusion does not apply if we approved the repair in writing beforehand.

6. General exclusions
6.1. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
6.2. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
6.3. We will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits us from paying.
6.4. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.
6.5. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
6.6. We will not pay for loss of value or loss of use that does not involve physical loss or damage.

7. Making a claim
7.1. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.
7.2. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
7.3. You must notify us of a claim within 60 days of the incident. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.

8. Interpretation
8.1. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the meaning of this policy.
8.2. Words in the singular include the plural and the other way round.
8.3. Words defined in the definitions section have the same meaning wherever they appear in bold or with an initial capital.

9. Replacement devices
9.1. If we cannot repair your device economically, we will replace it with a replacement device.
9.2. Replacement devices may be a different colour and may be refurbished to an as-new standard.
9.3. Accessories are replaced only if they were lost or damaged in the same incident as the device.

10. Inflation
10.1. We may adjust limits at renewal in line with a published index of consumer prices.
10.2. Any adjustment will be shown in your renewal documents; limits do not change during a policy period.

11. How to read this document
11.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
11.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
11.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

12. Repair process
12.1. After a claim is accepted, we will send a prepaid mailer or book a courier collection.
12.2. We aim to return repaired devices within 5 business days of receiving them.

13. Environmental commitment
13.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
13.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

14. Assignment
14.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

15. Recovery of costs
15.1. If we pay a claim that is later found not to be covered, we may ask you to repay the amount.

16. Market conditions
16.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

17. Automatic renewal
17.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
17.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

18. Salvage
18.1. When we replace an item, the damaged or recovered item becomes our property.
18.2. If stolen property is recovered after we have paid a claim, you must tell us and either return the payment or give us the property.

19. Instalment agreements
19.1. If you pay by instalments, the instalment agreement is a separate contract with the finance provider.
19.2. Ending the instalment agreement does not cancel this policy, but unpaid premium remains due.

20. Accessibility
20.1. This document is available in large print, braille or audio on request.

21. Other insurance
21.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
21.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

22. Change of address
22.1. You must tell us within 30 days if you change your address.
22.2. We may change the premium or the terms from the date of the move.

23. Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
23.1. A person who is not a party to this policy has no right to enforce any of its terms.

24. Arbitration
24.1. If we accept a claim but disagree with you about the amount, the difference will be referred to an arbitrator appointed by both parties.
24.2. Where arbitration applies, obtaining an award is a condition precedent to any legal action against us.

25. Claims documents
25.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.
25.2. We may ask for a medical certificate, a police report or a repair estimate, depending on the claim.

26. Payment of claims
26.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
26.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 5 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

27. Discounts
27.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
27.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

28. Sanctions
28.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

29. Communication
29.1. We will communicate with you in English.
29.2. We may record telephone calls for training and quality purposes.

30. Interest
30.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

31. Severability
31.1. If any term of this policy is found to be invalid, the remaining terms will continue in full force.

32. Data and backups
32.1. We are not responsible for recovering or restoring any data, software or settings stored on your device.
32.2. You should back up your data regularly and before sending the device for repair.

33. Exchange of information
33.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
33.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

34. Cancellation
34.1. You can cancel this policy within 14 days of receiving it and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made.
34.2. After the first 14 days you can cancel at any time; we will refund the premium for the unexpired period less an administration charge of $15.
34.3. We can cancel this policy by giving you 30 days' written notice to the last address we hold.

35. Third-party administrators
35.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.
35.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

36. Transferring the plan
36.1. You may transfer the plan to a new owner of the device by telling us in writing.
36.2. The remaining term of the plan transfers with the device; the term does not restart.

37. Geographical limits
37.1. Cover applies only within the territory shown in the schedule.
37.2. Cover for property temporarily away from its usual place applies only within the same country.

38. Unrecoverable devices
38.1. If a device is found after we have replaced it, the found device becomes our property and must be sent to us.
38.2. We may block devices reported as lost or stolen so that they cannot be used on mobile networks.

39. Reasonable precautions
39.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
39.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

40. Notices
40.1. Any notice we give under this policy will be sent to the most recent postal or email address we hold.
40.2. Notices from you should be sent to the address shown in the schedule.

41. Currency
41.1. All amounts in this policy are in US dollars.
41.2. Claims for costs incurred in another currency will be converted at the exchange rate on the date the cost was incurred.

42. Fraud
42.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.
42.2. We may share information with fraud prevention agencies and other insurers.

43. Data protection
43.1. We will use the personal information you provide to administer this policy and to handle claims.
43.2. We will keep personal information only for as long as it is needed for these purposes or as required by law.
43.3. You can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold by writing to our data protection officer.

44. Records and evidence
44.1. You should keep receipts, photographs and valuations for items of significant value.
44.2. Where proof of value is missing, we may base any settlement on the price of a comparable item.
44.3. We may ask for evidence of how and when an item was acquired.

45. Duty of fair presentation
45.1. You must answer all questions we ask honestly and to the best of your knowledge.
45.2. If you give incorrect information deliberately or recklessly, we may treat this policy as if it never existed and keep the premium.
45.3. If you give incorrect information carelessly, we may reduce any claim payment in proportion to the premium that should have been charged.

46. Complaints
46.1. If you have a complaint, you should first contact our customer relations team, quoting the policy number.
46.2. We will acknowledge a complaint within five working days and aim to resolve it within eight weeks.
46.3. If you remain dissatisfied, you may be able to refer the complaint to an independent ombudsman service.

47. Governing law
47.1. This policy is governed by the law of the jurisdiction in which it was issued, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.
47.2. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of that jurisdiction.

48. Electronic documents
48.1. We will send documents by email unless you ask for paper copies.
48.2. You must tell us if your email address changes.
48.3. Documents sent by email are treated as received on the day they are sent.

49. Taxes
49.1. The premium includes any insurance premium tax at the current rate.
49.2. If the tax rate changes, we may adjust the premium from the date of the change.

50. Compensation scheme
50.1. We are covered by a financial services compensation scheme.
50.2. If we cannot meet our obligations, you may be entitled to compensation from the scheme, depending on the type of policy and the circumstances.

51. Subrogation
51.1. We will be entitled to take over and conduct in your name the defence or settlement of any claim.
51.2. We can take action in your name to recover any payment we make from anyone responsible for the loss.

52. Cooperation
52.1. You must give us all the help and information we reasonably need to settle a claim.
52.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

53. Joint policyholders
53.1. Where more than one person is named in the schedule, each of them is treated as having knowledge of anything any of them knows.
53.2. A notice sent to one named person is treated as sent to all of them.

54. Software support
54.1. Our helpline can give advice on setting up and using your device.
54.2. Software support does not include fixing problems caused by third-party apps or unofficial operating systems.

55. Changes in circumstances
55.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.
55.2. We may then change the premium or the terms of this policy, or cancel it.

56. Renewal
56.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.
56.2. We are not obliged to offer renewal.

57. Customer support
57.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
57.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

58. Premium payment
58.1. You must pay the premium on or before the policy start date or in the monthly instalments shown in the schedule.
58.2. If an instalment is not paid within 21 days of its due date, we may cancel the policy after giving notice.

59. Waiver
59.1. If we do not enforce any term of this policy, that does not mean we have given up the right to enforce it later.

STAFF HEALTH REIMBURSEMENT PLAN RULES
Issued by Synthetic Policy Office 1

1. Definitions
1.1. Assessed loss means the cost of repair or replacement agreed by us, before any deductible, limit or sublimit is applied.
1.2. Family means your spouse or partner and any children who live with you.
1.3. Frames means spectacle frames bought without new lenses.
1.4. Hearing accessories means batteries, chargers and cleaning kits.
1.5. Hearing aid replacement period means 24 months from the purchase of hearing aids funded by the plan.
1.6. Incident means a single event, or a series of events arising from one cause.
1.7. Limit means the most we will pay for all claims under a section arising from one treatment.
1.8. Major restorative work means crowns, bridges, root canal treatment and implants.
1.9. Massage therapy means sports massage, massage therapy and reflexology.
1.10. Network provider means a practitioner or clinic that has an agreement with us to provide treatment.
1.11. Orthodontics means braces and clear aligners.
1.12. Plan year means the twelve months starting on your coverage start date.
1.13. Policy period means twelve months from the policy start date shown in your schedule.
1.14. Receipt means a document from the seller or provider showing the date, the amount paid and what was supplied.
1.15. Registered practitioner means a practitioner registered with the professional body for their discipline.
1.16. Replacement period means 24 months from the date of your last eyewear claim.
1.17. Schedule means the document issued with this policy that shows your details, the covers you bought and any extensions.

2. Limits and deductible
2.1. Dental Care: limit $1,500 per treatment; deductible $100 per claim.
2.2. Vision Care: limit $400 per treatment; deductible $25 per claim.
2.3. Therapy Services: limit $2,000 per treatment; deductible $75 per claim.
2.4. Hearing Care: limit $1,000 per treatment; deductible $100 per claim.
2.5. The deductible is deducted from the assessed loss before any limit or sublimit is applied.

3. Therapy Services
3.1. We will reimburse physiotherapy, osteopathy and counselling provided by a registered practitioner.
3.2. The most we will pay for Massage therapy under this section is $200 per treatment.
3.3. We will not pay for treatment of an injury covered by workers' compensation.
3.4. We will not pay for treatment by a practitioner who is not registered with the relevant professional body.

4. Vision Care
4.1. We will reimburse eye tests and prescription eyewear.
4.2. The most we will pay for Frames under this section is $150 per treatment.
4.3. We will not pay for eyewear without prescription lenses.
4.4. We will not pay for a further eyewear claim within the replacement period.

5. Dental Care
5.1. We will reimburse the cost of dental treatment provided by a licensed dentist.
5.2. No cover applies under this section to any treatment that happens within the first 60 days after the policy start date.
5.3. The most we will pay for Major restorative work under this section is $500 per treatment.
5.4. The most we will pay for Orthodontics under this section is $600 per treatment.
5.5. We will not pay for treatment that is mainly cosmetic, such as whitening or veneers. This exclusion does not apply to treatment needed to repair damage caused by an accident.
5.6. We will not pay for treatment by a provider outside the plan's network. This exclusion does not apply to emergency treatment for sudden severe pain.

6. Optional cover: Hearing Care
6.1. We will reimburse hearing tests and hearing aids.
6.2. This section applies only if it is shown as purchased in your schedule.
6.3. The most we will pay for Hearing accessories under this section is $100 per treatment.
6.4. We will not pay for replacement hearing aids bought within the hearing aid replacement period.

7. General exclusions
7.1. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.
7.2. We will not pay for loss of value or loss of use that does not involve physical loss or damage.
7.3. We will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits us from paying.
7.4. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
7.5. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.

8. Making a claim
8.1. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.
8.2. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
8.3. You must notify us of a claim within 30 days of the treatment. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.

9. Geographical limits
9.1. Cover applies only within the territory shown in the schedule.
9.2. Cover for property temporarily away from its usual place applies only within the same country.

10. Market conditions
10.1. If the replacement item is no longer available, we will pay the cost of the nearest equivalent available at the time of the claim.

11. Interest
11.1. We will not pay interest on any claim payment unless the law requires it.

12. Accessibility
12.1. This document is available in large print, braille or audio on request.

13. Reasonable precautions
13.1. You must take all reasonable steps to prevent loss or damage and to keep property in good condition.
13.2. You must take reasonable steps to recover lost or stolen property.

14. Claims documents
14.1. You must provide, at your own expense, original receipts, invoices, reports and any other evidence we reasonably ask for.
14.2. We may ask for a medical certificate, a police report or a repair estimate, depending on the claim.

15. Discounts
15.1. Any discount shown in the schedule applies only while the conditions for it continue to be met.
15.2. If a condition for a discount stops being met, we may charge the premium without the discount from that date.

16. Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
16.1. A person who is not a party to this policy has no right to enforce any of its terms.

17. Assignment
17.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

18. Taxes
18.1. The premium includes any insurance premium tax at the current rate.
18.2. If the tax rate changes, we may adjust the premium from the date of the change.

19. Complaints
19.1. If you have a complaint, you should first contact our customer relations team, quoting the policy number.
19.2. We will acknowledge a complaint within five working days and aim to resolve it within eight weeks.
19.3. If you remain dissatisfied, you may be able to refer the complaint to an independent ombudsman service.

20. Notices
20.1. Any notice we give under this policy will be sent to the most recent postal or email address we hold.
20.2. Notices from you should be sent to the address shown in the schedule.

21. Electronic documents
21.1. We will send documents by email unless you ask for paper copies.
21.2. You must tell us if your email address changes.
21.3. Documents sent by email are treated as received on the day they are sent.

22. Sanctions
22.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

23. Governing law
23.1. This policy is governed by the law of the jurisdiction in which it was issued, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.
23.2. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of that jurisdiction.

24. Coordination of benefits
24.1. If a treatment is also covered by another plan, we will pay only the part of the cost that the other plan does not pay.
24.2. You must tell us about any other plan that covers you or your dependants.

25. Fraud
25.1. If any claim is fraudulent or exaggerated in any respect, we will not pay the claim and all cover under this policy may be cancelled.
25.2. We may share information with fraud prevention agencies and other insurers.

26. Compensation scheme
26.1. We are covered by a financial services compensation scheme.
26.2. If we cannot meet our obligations, you may be entitled to compensation from the scheme, depending on the type of policy and the circumstances.

27. Environmental commitment
27.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
27.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

28. Cancellation
28.1. You can cancel this policy within 14 days of receiving it and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made.
28.2. After the first 14 days you can cancel at any time; we will refund the premium for the unexpired period less an administration charge of $15.
28.3. We can cancel this policy by giving you 30 days' written notice to the last address we hold.

29. Eligibility
29.1. Employees who work at least 20 hours a week are eligible to join the plan from their first day of employment.
29.2. Contractors, agency workers and employees on unpaid leave of more than three months are not eligible.

30. Arbitration
30.1. If we accept a claim but disagree with you about the amount, the difference will be referred to an arbitrator appointed by both parties.
30.2. Where arbitration applies, obtaining an award is a condition precedent to any legal action against us.

31. Recovery of costs
31.1. If we pay a claim that is later found not to be covered, we may ask you to repay the amount.

32. Payment of claims
32.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
32.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 5 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

33. Currency
33.1. All amounts in this policy are in US dollars.
33.2. Claims for costs incurred in another currency will be converted at the exchange rate on the date the cost was incurred.

34. Wellness allowance
34.1. Each plan year you may claim up to $250 towards a gym membership or fitness class.
34.2. The wellness allowance is not subject to any deductible and does not count towards other limits.

35. Other insurance
35.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
35.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

36. Inflation
36.1. We may adjust limits at renewal in line with a published index of consumer prices.
36.2. Any adjustment will be shown in your renewal documents; limits do not change during a policy period.

37. Automatic renewal
37.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
37.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

38. Change of address
38.1. You must tell us within 30 days if you change your address.
38.2. We may change the premium or the terms from the date of the move.

39. Subrogation
39.1. We will be entitled to take over and conduct in your name the defence or settlement of any claim.
39.2. We can take action in your name to recover any payment we make from anyone responsible for the loss.

40. Waiver
40.1. If we do not enforce any term of this policy, that does not mean we have given up the right to enforce it later.

41. Communication
41.1. We will communicate with you in English.
41.2. We may record telephone calls for training and quality purposes.

42. Customer support
42.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
42.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

43. Appeals
43.1. If we decline all or part of a claim, you may appeal in writing within 60 days of the decision.
43.2. An appeal will be reviewed by someone who was not involved in the original decision.
43.3. We will give you a written decision on the appeal within 30 days.

44. Severability
44.1. If any term of this policy is found to be invalid, the remaining terms will continue in full force.

45. Salvage
45.1. When we replace an item, the damaged or recovered item becomes our property.
45.2. If stolen property is recovered after we have paid a claim, you must tell us and either return the payment or give us the property.

46. Cooperation
46.1. You must give us all the help and information we reasonably need to settle a claim.
46.2. You must not admit liability or offer to settle any claim without our written permission.

47. Duty of fair presentation
47.1. You must answer all questions we ask honestly and to the best of your knowledge.
47.2. If you give incorrect information deliberately or recklessly, we may treat this policy as if it never existed and keep the premium.
47.3. If you give incorrect information carelessly, we may reduce any claim payment in proportion to the premium that should have been charged.

48. Joint policyholders
48.1. Where more than one person is named in the schedule, each of them is treated as having knowledge of anything any of them knows.
48.2. A notice sent to one named person is treated as sent to all of them.

49. Renewal
49.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.
49.2. We are not obliged to offer renewal.

50. Instalment agreements
50.1. If you pay by instalments, the instalment agreement is a separate contract with the finance provider.
50.2. Ending the instalment agreement does not cancel this policy, but unpaid premium remains due.

51. Premium payment
51.1. You must pay the premium on or before the policy start date or in the monthly instalments shown in the schedule.
51.2. If an instalment is not paid within 14 days of its due date, we may cancel the policy after giving notice.

52. Dependants
52.1. You may enrol dependants at the start of each plan year or within 30 days of a qualifying life event.
52.2. Benefits paid for dependants count towards the same annual limits as your own claims.

53. Leaving the plan
53.1. Cover ends on the day your employment ends or the day you stop being eligible, whichever is earlier.
53.2. Claims for treatment received before cover ended may be submitted up to 90 days afterwards.

54. Records and evidence
54.1. You should keep receipts, photographs and valuations for items of significant value.
54.2. Where proof of value is missing, we may base any settlement on the price of a comparable item.
54.3. We may ask for evidence of how and when an item was acquired.

55. Interpretation
55.1. Headings are for convenience only and do not affect the meaning of this policy.
55.2. Words in the singular include the plural and the other way round.
55.3. Words defined in the definitions section have the same meaning wherever they appear in bold or with an initial capital.

56. Third-party administrators
56.1. We may appoint another company to handle claims or other services on our behalf.
56.2. Any company we appoint must follow the terms of this policy and applicable data protection law.

57. Changes in circumstances
57.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.
57.2. We may then change the premium or the terms of this policy, or cancel it.

58. Exchange of information
58.1. To prevent fraud, we may check the details you give against public records and industry databases.
58.2. We may contact previous insurers to confirm your claims history.

59. Data protection
59.1. We will use the personal information you provide to administer this policy and to handle claims.
59.2. We will keep personal information only for as long as it is needed for these purposes or as required by law.
59.3. You can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold by writing to our data protection officer.

60. How to read this document
60.1. This document, the schedule and any endorsements form one contract and should be read together.
60.2. Where the schedule and this document conflict, the schedule applies.
60.3. Examples given in this document are for illustration only and do not limit the meaning of any term.

6.2. An appeal will be reviewed by someone who was not involved in the original decision.
6.3. We will give you a written decision on the appeal within 30 days.

7. Vision Care
7.1. We will reimburse eye tests and prescription eyewear.
7.2. The most we will pay for Frames under this section is $120 per treatment.
7.3. We will not pay for eyewear without prescription lenses.
7.4. We will not pay for a further eyewear claim within the replacement period.

8. Sanctions
8.1. We will not provide cover or pay any claim to the extent that doing so would expose us to any sanction or restriction under applicable trade or economic sanctions laws.

9. Salvage
9.1. When we replace an item, the damaged or recovered item becomes our property.
9.2. If stolen property is recovered after we have paid a claim, you must tell us and either return the payment or give us the property.

10. Data protection
10.1. We will use the personal information you provide to administer this policy and to handle claims.
10.2. We will keep personal information only for as long as it is needed for these purposes or as required by law.
10.3. You can ask for a copy of the personal information we hold by writing to our data protection officer.

11. Therapy Services
11.1. We will reimburse physiotherapy, osteopathy and counselling provided by a registered practitioner.
11.2. The most we will pay for Massage therapy under this section is $200 per treatment.
11.3. We will not pay for treatment of an injury covered by workers' compensation.
11.4. We will not pay for treatment by a practitioner who is not registered with the relevant professional body.

12. Other insurance
12.1. If any loss covered by this policy is also covered by another policy, we will pay only our proportionate share.
12.2. You must tell us about any other insurance that covers the same loss when you make a claim.

13. Coordination of benefits
13.1. If a treatment is also covered by another plan, we will pay only the part of the cost that the other plan does not pay.
13.2. You must tell us about any other plan that covers you or your dependants.

14. Environmental commitment
14.1. Where practical, we will repair rather than replace damaged items and will use recycled or refurbished parts.
14.2. You may ask for a new part instead, and we will tell you whether any additional cost would apply.

15. Assignment
15.1. You cannot transfer your interest in this policy to anyone else without our written consent.

16. Renewal
16.1. We will write to you at least 21 days before the end of the policy period with the renewal terms.
16.2. We are not obliged to offer renewal.

17. Changes in circumstances
17.1. You must tell us as soon as reasonably possible about any change in the information shown in the schedule.
17.2. We may then change the premium or the terms of this policy, or cancel it.

18. Dental Care
18.1. We will reimburse the cost of dental treatment provided by a licensed dentist.
18.2. No cover applies under this section to any treatment that happens within the first 90 days after the policy start date.
18.3. The most we will pay for Major restorative work under this section is $500 per treatment.
18.4. The most we will pay for Orthodontics under this section is $600 per treatment.
18.5. We will not pay for treatment that is mainly cosmetic, such as whitening or veneers. This exclusion does not apply to treatment needed to repair damage caused by an accident.
18.6. We will not pay for treatment by a provider outside the plan's network. This exclusion does not apply to emergency treatment for sudden severe pain.

19. General exclusions
19.1. We will not pay for loss of value or loss of use that does not involve physical loss or damage.
19.2. We will not pay for loss or damage caused by war, invasion, or civil war.
19.3. We will not pay for loss arising from a government order or sanction that prohibits us from paying.
19.4. We will not pay for any deliberate or criminal act by you.
19.5. We will not pay for loss caused by nuclear radiation or radioactive contamination.
19.6. We will not pay for any fraudulent claim or any claim supported by false documents.

20. Customer support
20.1. Our helpline is open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Saturdays.
20.2. Outside these hours you can leave a message and we will call back on the next working day.

21. Making a claim
21.1. You must notify us of a claim within 60 days of the treatment. We will not pay any claim notified after that time.
21.2. You must provide proof of ownership or of the cost incurred for every item or service claimed.
21.3. We may appoint a loss adjuster to investigate any claim.

22. Automatic renewal
22.1. Unless you tell us otherwise, this policy will renew automatically at the end of the policy period using the payment details we hold.
22.2. You can switch off automatic renewal at any time by contacting our helpline.

23. Payment of claims
23.1. We will pay claims by bank transfer to an account in your name.
23.2. We aim to pay accepted claims within 10 working days of receiving all the documents we need.

24. Waiver
24.1. If we do not enforce any term of this policy, that does not mean we have given up the right to enforce it later.

25. Premium payment
25.1. You must pay the premium on or before the policy start date or in the monthly instalments shown in the schedule.
25.2. If an instalment is not paid within 7 days of its due date, we may cancel the policy after giving notice.
